He is family-minded, and sends part of his military pay to his parents and younger sister living in New York. Influenced by his parents, who were musicians, he loves music, and his treasured CD player is, by his own account, the third most important thing to him after his life. He particularly likes rock and jazz. His dream for the future is to work in show business and run a theater that stages musicals and the like. A self-declared and generally acknowledged "feminist" (in the Japanese sense of being gallant toward women), he gets on good terms with Rose before anyone notices.
uncertain: 'Feminist' in the Japanese sense of a man who is gallant toward women; kept in quotes with a gloss.
'Gentle and strong' translates the set phrase 'ki wa yasashikute chikara mochi'.

154.en: A member of the Practice Squad, the elite unit under Meio. He is 19 years old and holds the rank of warrant officer. The Practice Squad was also called the "boys' unit," which is an apt description. He is the only one of the three to die in battle, and that, too, was to protect Meio, as one would expect.

155.en: A lieutenant colonel of the Giganos Empire. Known as a radical, he proposes indiscriminate all-out attacks with mass drivers, and so on. Each time, however, Guiltorre admonishes him, and he seems to be inwardly irritated that his opinions are not accepted. He is interested only in winning this war and has no perspective on what to do with the world after the war. He is an ambitious man with both baseness and pettiness, but the image of a small-fry sticks to him.
uncertain: 'Dorchenov' (Wikipedia) vs. 'Dolchenov'.

156.en: His full name is Lang Plato. He is the father of Linda and Meio. A scientist who was the chief of Metal Armor development for the Giganos military and who designed and developed the three Dragonars. But to weed out the seeds of war he had sown himself, after the outbreak of war he defected to the Earth Alliance with the Dragonars, and is working on the Dragoon mass-production plan at the Chongqing base. His love for his family is deep, as shown by his remembering the clothing size of his ex-wife, but it does not seem to get through to his children very well. Despite carrying a heavy past, he normally plays a cheerful old guy. His favorite food is Chinese steamed buns.

157.en: The demon sergeant appointed as the training officer for Kaine and the others. It is hard enough just to give soldier training to the three goofballs, and as the person in charge of training he is also scolded by Lieutenant Douglas, so it is a thankless role. In the end, however, considering that he marries a certain person, he can be called a lucky man. He has a bold personality, but is surprisingly meticulous, and is a dependable big-brother figure to the three.
uncertain: Gender: no English source states it; male assumed from ja Wikipedia (he marries Diane) and the 'big brother' wording. Flag if a source says otherwise.

158.en: A young ace of the Giganos Imperial Guard Armored Corps, known as the "Blue Hawk of Giganos." He is 24 years old with the rank of captain. He agrees with the ideology of Giganos and is trusted by Guiltorre, but carries the burden of being the son of a traitor. Calm and confident, he is blessed with the qualities of a commander who makes accurate decisions, and he has many believers within the military. For that reason he also has many enemies, and attempts to bring him down never cease. In the latter half of the story he completely steals the show with his activity, and is highly regarded as the hidden protagonist. The last scene of the final episode in particular is a must-see.
uncertain: 'Meio' (Wikipedia/MAL) vs. kana Maillo/Maillot.

159.en: One of Gon Jem's Four Heavenly Kings, a tall woman who pilots the Stark Dein. Her rank is captain. She is quite strong, and it is said that no one who teased her got away unharmed. She is the sole woman in the Gon Jem Squad and a gutsy big-sister figure, but shows a cute side toward a man she acknowledges as stronger than herself. Her skill is solid, and she survived to the end even after the Gon Jem Squad was wiped out, and snatched the best parts.

160.en: A 17-year-old student at the same Astronaut Academy as Kaine, who carries noble blood. He becomes the pilot of Dragonar-3. He is deeply versed in electronics, and seems to have taken to Dragonar-3, the electronic warfare machine, at first sight. Among the three he is comparatively calm and intellectual, but since he is basically a goofball, he often plays the part of the comic handsome guy. His role is to stop Kaine, who runs ahead alone. He is a rich family's young master, but he rebelled against that and entered the Astronaut Academy. However, thanks to the environment he grew up in, he can handle social pleasantries properly and is skilled with ladies, and he also shows off his dandy side, being fussy about food.
uncertain: 'Comic handsome guy' for [jp] (a handsome man who plays the clown).

161.en: One of the refugees aboard the transport ship Idaho. Her pensive eyes have a maturity that hardly seems that of a 16-year-old. But that is natural: she has a major secret and has been living with a thorn in her heart. She stubbornly refuses Kaine's ardent advances at first, but gradually opens her heart. Her knowledge of electronics is also considerable.

165.en: A 16-year-old refugee girl who was aboard the transport ship Idaho. She is traveling with Linda to look for her parents, from whom she was separated on the Moon. She is full of energy and cheerful, the type who naturally soothes those around her. As the only ordinary person among the three heroines, her ordinariness conversely shone. She quickly entered a steady relationship with Tapp.

271.en: Dr. Izumi's granddaughter and the sub-pilot of the Gulver FXII. In the early days she wore a flight cap with goggles when sortieing, but before long she went without a helmet. She calls Kazuya, who was raised with her like a brother, "Big Brother," and has feelings for him, but she realizes Kazuya's feelings for Erika and steps aside. A tomboy who learns karate like Kazuya, she has black-belt-level skill. Also, perhaps because of Dr. Izumi's influence, she is good at tinkering with machines, and once built a see-through camera. When she gets excited or troubled, she has a strange habit of imitating a dog by saying "Uu~, woof!"

272.en: The person in charge of Daimobic. He is a father-substitute to Kazuya and his karate teacher. He has also displayed karate techniques such as flying kicks and body strikes, with the "Swallow Double Kick" as his specialty. He has a strong sense of justice and is humane, and is highly respected. It is also thanks to Dr. Izumi that Daimobic can fight on its own judgment without being at the beck and call of Commander Miwa, even though Daimobic receives subsidies from the government. He is a first-rate scientist as well, and often holds the key to a turnaround, such as manufacturing the Photon Missile when he felt threatened by the appearance of the Cobrado, and using the power of Daimolite to change Daimos into a pure energy state. However, he loves sweets, and since he sometimes directed battles while licking a lollipop, I cannot help feeling that his dignity was somewhat lacking. In episode 30, "Danger! Dr. Izumi's Life," he was badly injured trying to protect the Daimolite storehouse and was implanted with an artificial cerebellum made by Baam.
uncertain: 'Cobrado' ([jp]) is a Baam command ship per ja Wikipedia; romanized from kana.
The 'I cannot help feeling' comment is the writer's own voice in the Japanese.
Episode 30 title translated by me ('Danger! Dr. Izumi's Life').

273.en: The daughter of the late Grand Marshal Leon and the sister of Admiral Richter. She had gone to the front lines as a budding doctor to treat soldiers, but the battle saucer she was riding was shot down, and she lost her memory from the shock; Kazuya rescued her and they fell in love. After regaining her memory, she leaves Daimobic, but is confined in the Undersea Castle, and as she is about to be executed for treason, she escapes with the help of her mentor, Hospital Director Worin. After that, too, she is toyed with by a strange fate, drifting from place to place and repeatedly missing her beloved Kazuya. After becoming the new leader of the liberation organization, she resolves to fight for peace by a method different from Kazuya's, and becomes a star of hope for both Baam people who wish for peace and Earth activists. She was originally a woman with the triple qualities of being strong, gentle and beautiful, but her love with Kazuya made her grow greatly in spirit.
uncertain: 'Grand Marshal' for [jp] (English Wikipedia says 'Emperor Leon').

274.en: Erika's nursemaid. She calls Erika "Ohiisama" (my little princess). Because the late Grand Marshal Leon had asked her to look after the futures of the two siblings, she was one of the few people who could admonish Richter inside the Undersea Demon Castle. She has not aged in vain, and noticed the relationship between Erika and Kazuya right away. She kept supporting Erika and Kazuya's relationship, and for that she was charged with treason, had her wings cut off and was made to do forced labor. After being rescued by the Liberation Army, she became a pillar of support as the guardian of Erika, who had become the new leader.
uncertain: 'Ohiisama' kept in romanization with a gloss.

275.en: The pilot of the Gulver FXII and a maxim enthusiast. A close friend of Kazuya, with whom he served aboard Space Daimobic. He plays the cool nihilist, but has a strong sense of justice and cannot be stopped once he flares up. He says spiteful things to Kazuya at every turn, but there are signs that he says them to spur Kazuya on. He grew up in France, and after losing his mother in early childhood he was taken in by his grandfather, Ittosai Yuzuki, and had swordsmanship drilled into him, so his sword skill is first-rate. He is a cautious man who never lets go of the sword on his back, whatever the situation. But he seems to be bad with women, and keeps his distance on the principle that "a wise man does not approach danger." His glasses are for show, but his head is not for show, and his hairstyle has been the same since childhood.
uncertain: 'Ittosai Yuzuki' romanized from kana.

276.en: The pilot of Daimos and a karate master. A former astronaut who brought Daimolite back aboard Space Daimobic, dispatched by the International Space Agency. Because his father was posted to the Moon base when he was five, he was raised with Dr. Izumi as a surrogate parent, and was taught karate and shooting. After returning to Earth, he belongs to the Daimobic base, and following his father's last wishes he becomes Daimos's pilot and fights the Baam Earth conquest army. He has a straightforward personality and the stubbornness to stick to his own convictions. In an accident during astronaut training he was left completely paralyzed and once almost gave up on his dream, but he has a past of recovering through bloody effort, and his mental strength is guaranteed. He comes to love the amnesiac girl Erika, and that love will in time lead the universe to peace. His hobby of playing drums is at a professional level. Also, there is data that he tends his hair only once every 36 days.
uncertain: 'International Space Agency' ([jp]) is my translation.

277.en: A member of the Koplander Team. She has precognitive ability and the ability to hear Raideen's inner voice, so she gives Akira and the others advice that only she can give. She is a wise and calm woman, the opposite of Mari, and Mari always suspected her relationship with Akira. In the past, in search of something to live for and something to be absorbed in, she was also a member of a biker gang.

278.en: Akira's classmate and the idol of Rinkai Gakuen. She is the daughter of Director Higashiyama of the Future Engineering Research Institute, with a cheerful, tomboyish personality, and Akira often teased her about how scatterbrained she was. She becomes a pillar of support for the fighting Akira, and in the end, with the sole wish of helping Akira, joins the Koplander Team and backs up Raideen in Bluegar.

279.en: The director of the Future Engineering Research Institute and the father of Mari Sakurano. To counter the invasion of the Demon Empire, he built the science fortress Mutropolis. While directing it, he formed the Koplander Team to back up Raideen.

280.en: A sporty boy who serves as captain of the soccer club at Rinkai Gakuen. He is destined to become one (fade-in) with Raideen, the legacy of King Ra Mu. To prevent the arrival of the Age of Demons, he fights the Demon Empire with Raideen. He is a hot-blooded man of justice with a cheerful personality, and has the strength not to lose to his own destiny and the courage not to flinch even in desperate situations.
uncertain: 'King Ra Mu' here vs. 'emperor' in the Raideen unit entry (the source wording differs: [jp] vs [jp]).
'Age of Demons' for [jp].

281.en: Akira's father and an archaeologist. In the original story, in episode 1 he is turned to stone along with the ship he was on by the Demon forces, and later falls into Sharkin's hands.

338.en: Akira's mother, who is missing. In truth she is Princess Lemuria of the ancient Mu Empire. To prevent the revival of the Great Demon Emperor Barao and his ambitions, she had fallen into a twelve-thousand-year sleep. Awakening in the present day, she married Ichirou Hibiki and gave birth to Akira, then disappeared to search for the Star of Ra Mu, the secret treasure of the Mu Empire.

395.en: The commander of the Earth Defense Force Pacific Regional Headquarters, who also serves concurrently as Japan's chief of national defense. He is, above all, a belligerent man who thinks a few sacrifices are unavoidable in order to win battles. He seems to want to become a hero, and in order to produce results he attacks indiscriminately, including civilians, and tortures prisoners. A born militarist who declares that civilians are noncombatants and so are a burden, useless mouths to feed, and lower than dogs. He believes all Baam people should be exterminated, and dislikes Kazuya, who shields Erika. He also has a hysterical side, immediately hurling discriminatory words at anyone who does not follow his wishes. In the end, he is arrested on charges of repeatedly ignoring orders from the military's upper echelons.
uncertain: 'Chief of national defense' for [jp] (could be 'Minister of Defense').
Name order: Sakimori (given) Miwa (family).

50.en: An operator of the Earth defense organization GEAR. She looks like a trendy girl, but is in fact a woman of many talents, 22 years old and born on Valentine's Day. Her ability with computers is especially high, and she is the only one who has beaten the central computer Meteo at chess. She wanted a clerical job in hopes of retiring early to marry, but she is a super woman who can even serve as a sub-pilot of the Cell Fighter.
uncertain: [jp] rendered "retiring early to marry" (quitting a job upon marriage)

51.en: The chip of Giga Absolute, one of the three Machine Generals of Spiral Castle. The chip is a copy, but because bugs occurred along with the miniaturization, it has come to act foolishly. It can already be called a mechanical life form separate from the main body. Absolute is the leader of the three, and speaks with "dawa" at the end of its sentences.
uncertain: "it" used for the chip (JA Wikipedia: Galfa machines have no gender)
[jp] rendered "Machine General" (Akurasu); Wikipedia calls the three "generals"

52.en: The pilot of Knight GEAR Ogre who came from the Gulfer home planet. The Gears require a human as pilot. He is also the captain of Gulfer Emperor's guard and holds the title of Black Knight. He always wears a mask, so his true face is unknown, and although he is only human, he has been entrusted with full authority over capturing the data weapons and looks down on the three Machine Generals. For that reason he often clashes with the three Machine Generals. He has a deep-rooted history with Vega.
uncertain: Gender "he" taken from the glossary (JA Wikipedia); the text itself does not say, and the pilot is masked in this entry
Name spelling: Altair / Arthea / Althea

54.en: Vega's older brother and the prince of Alktos. He is Hokuto's uncle. He was originally a kind older brother who cared for his younger sister, but in a past battle his memory was manipulated by Gulfer Emperor, and he had been opposing humanity. After a long fight he recovers his memory, and from then on fights alongside the others, aiming to defeat Gulfer. Like Vega, he has considerable fighting power even without a machine. Also, because Altair's memory came back, Ogre raised the visor on its head and showed its original face.
uncertain: Original has no subject for the memory-manipulation sentence: restored as "his memory ... by Emperor Galfa"

55.en: Ginga's younger sister. She calls Ginga "Gin-nii." She is quite a tomboy, and scribbling on the poster of Ginga's favorite idol is an everyday occurrence. She is surprisingly dependable and sometimes shows a sharpness unlike a three-year-old. With a child's high adaptability, she even becomes friends with Leo Circle.

56.en: A bright, energetic 11-year-old boy who attends Hoshimi Elementary School. His father works as a correspondent for a regional magazine and is often away from Japan. He is the hot-blooded, straightforward type who is better at moving his body than thinking, but once his spirit breaks, he also has the bad side of losing motivation for everything. Chosen as a Dendoh pilot together with Hokuto, he received the blue Gear Commander. He has learned Shorinji Kempo from his mother since he was little, and its movements are used in Dendoh's actions. At first he seems to have ridden simply because it looked cool, but he gradually awakens to his mission. He has a strong competitive spirit and took on the role of pulling along Hokuto, who is toyed with by a strange fate. His favorite idol is Yuki-chan of C-DRiVE, and her fan-club-only poster seems to be more precious to Ginga than his life.
uncertain: "Yuki-chan" kept as written (Yuki, member of C-DRiVE)

58.en: Ginga's mother, age 36. She was the 15th leader of Hiroshima's strongest lady gang, "Andromeda," but fell in love at first sight with Genichi Izumo and married him, and had two children, Ginga and Otome. Her Shorinji Kempo, which she has continued since her lady-gang days, is at the level of an instructor's assistant, and every day she drills Ginga hard under the teaching "Strength is heart." She also has a firm, upright character and never forgives injustice or wrongdoing.
uncertain: [jp] rendered "Genichi Izumo" (JA Wikipedia gives [jp])
[jp] rendered "Andromeda"
[jp] rendered "leader"; [jp] rendered "instructor's assistant"

59.en: The chip of Giga Witter, one of the three Machine Generals of Spiral Castle. Like the other two, it was sent to Earth to search for Dendoh's pilots and the data weapons. Of the three, Witter has the weakest sense of mission and gets bored easily. It speaks with "jan" at the end of its sentences.
uncertain: "it" used for the chip

60.name_jp: エリス・ウィラメット
60.en: A genius girl who graduated from MIT (Massachusetts Institute of Technology) at age 11. She was scouted by GEAR as the youngest person ever, and has been entrusted with the post of chief analyst of data weapons. She has none of the unpleasantness common to elites; she loves animals and is a kind-hearted girl. Her mental age is indeed high, and at times she treated Ginga and the others like children. Her hobby is bass fishing, and she says its charm lies in an uncertainty that is not just logic.
uncertain: Eris / Elise spelling
JA/EN Wikipedia say she graduated at 10; the game text says 11 (kept as in the game)

61.en: A boar-type data weapon that symbolizes "Creation." It has an impulsive, clumsy personality, and also serves as the leader of the data weapons. It rarely materialized to fight, but it was used frequently as a weapon. Its attribute is "Light."

62.en: The emperor of the machine empire Gulfer, which plots to exterminate humanity.

63.name_jp: 機将ギガアブゾルート
63.en: One of the three executives of Spiral Castle. In Ginga's words, "pompous guy number 3." Its body is made of liquid metal, and it changes shape to dodge enemy attacks or entangle opponents. It is also quick, and good at surprise attacks by seeping into walls.
uncertain: "it" used (machine)
[jp] rendered "three executives" (the other entries say 3[jp] = three Machine Generals)

64.en: One of the three executives of Spiral Castle. In Ginga's words, "a pompous kendama." It generates powerful electromagnetic waves from its main body and has the ability to disable all electronic equipment. Also, as long as its head, the core, is not destroyed, its body will regenerate any number of times.
uncertain: [jp] rendered "kendama" (the Japanese cup-and-ball toy)

65.en: One of the three executives of Spiral Castle. In Ginga's words, "pompous guy number 2." It deploys an electromagnetic interference field around itself and has the ability to hinder the materialization of data weapons. It emits electric shocks from its arms and fires a beam cannon from its mouth. It is also quite a power fighter.

66.en: One of the Machine Knights that infiltrated Earth hidden in meteorites, the one that emerged from a meteorite that fell near Mikazuki Island. Machine Knights are higher beings than machine beasts and possess high intelligence. It excels at high-speed aerial combat and can also transform into a flight form. The Photon Rifle is a versatile weapon that can also transform into a Photon Scythe.
uncertain: [jp] rendered "Photon Scythe" (JA Wikipedia says the rifle becomes a beam scythe)

67.en: One of the Machine Knights that infiltrated Earth hidden in meteorites, the one that emerged from a meteorite that fell in the wasteland of the Oceania continent. Its weapons are the Photon Laser fired from its forehead and electric shocks from the wings on its back. It is the Machine Knight that dodged the Final Attack and remained to the end.

68.en: One of the Machine Knights that infiltrated Earth hidden in meteorites, the one that emerged from a meteorite that fell in the Amazon jungle of the South American continent. It excels at tricky attacks with its extendable arms.

69.en: One of the Machine Knights that infiltrated Earth hidden in meteorites, the one that emerged from a meteorite that fell in the Sahara Desert of the African continent. It has the ability to heat its whole body white-hot and explode everything in the surrounding area.

70.en: A pilot of the Earth defense organization GEAR, age 26. He was originally a hero-loving young man working at the Hoshimi Amusement Park, but happened to discover the GEAR headquarters and forcibly became a member. At first he was a candidate for Dendoh pilot together with Vega, but because Hokuto and Ginga were chosen, he became support personnel. He is an expert at clay-pigeon shooting.
uncertain: The entry name [jp] is read Kirakuni Susumu (family name Kirakuni): rendered "Susumu Kirakuni"

71.en: Hokuto's mother, age 29. In fact she is the young lady of the Saionji family, said to be a shadow power in the political and business world. Despite her gentle appearance she is good at sports and highly intelligent; she became a university student by skipping grades, met Keisuke Kusanagi, and married him after a great romance. She has only just moved into Hoshimi Town and runs the cafe Polar at her home. Her specialty dish is beef stew.
uncertain: "Saionji family" kept as written; the text does not identify Orie with Vega

72.en: Hokuto's father, age 32. He works as an announcer in the news department of Nitto TV. In his younger days he lived only for work, and he secretly feels guilty that he could not pay attention to his son, so recently he keeps inviting Hokuto to watch soccer. Taking a daughter of the Saionji family as his wife shows that he has quite a bit of nerve.

73.en: A fifth-grader who transferred to Hoshimi Elementary School. He is Ginga's classmate and next-door neighbor. He is an honor student who thinks first before acting, a personality opposite to Ginga's, so at first they clashed, but they gradually become best partners. Though an honor student, he has a surprisingly lively side, and seems to be popular with both boys and girls in his class. On the very day he moved in, he was chosen with Ginga as a Dendoh pilot and received the black Gear Commander. He has a strong sense of responsibility; he is afraid of riding Dendoh, but thinks that if only the two of them can do it, they have no choice but to do it. He also has deep knowledge about computers and has even hacked the school's computer. Also, he casually uses the word "Newtype," so he may well be a big anime fan. His hobbies are soccer and billiards, and his pet dog is named Jupiter.
uncertain: [jp]: could be misread as Ginga being the one who thinks first; read as Hokuto thinks first (Ginga acts first, per the Ginga entry)

75.en: The chip of Giga Gourmet, one of the three Machine Generals of Spiral Castle. The chips have meta-traced into human form so that they can move more easily, but their true form is android. Of the three, Gourmet is the one who can come up with the most sensible plans. It speaks with "bari" at the end of its sentences.
uncertain: "it" used for the chip

76.en: A shadowy powerful figure who controls Japan's political and business world from behind the scenes. Seventeen years ago he helped a girl who had flown in from space and raised her as his daughter. At that time he learned of the existence of Gulfer, and to protect Earth from Gulfer's hands he threw away his private fortune and established the Earth defense organization GEAR.

77.en: The chief of the Earth defense organization GEAR, age 58. GEAR is an abbreviation of Guard Earth and Advanced Reconnaissance, meaning "an organization for Earth defense and cutting-edge research." Chief Shibuya has been deeply involved since its founding and is also the only person who knows the true identity of deputy commander Vega. As commander he sometimes makes harsh decisions, but he is a father figure full of kindness who worries about the children, and keeps together GEAR, which has many young people. He holds 3rd dan in kendo, 2nd dan in judo and 3rd dan in calligraphy, and after retirement he plans to open a pottery class in his hometown of Shizuoka.
uncertain: [jp] rendered "chief" (ANN: Chief Shibuya); could be "Director" / "Commissioner"
The original English expansion is written in full-width letters in the game and was kept

79.en: A boy raised as Gulfer Emperor's son and Altair's younger brother. He had been taught by Gulfer Emperor that he was the rightful successor to Ogre, but in reality it seems he was regarded as a spare. Because he grew up in the machine empire, he is poor at expressing emotions and cannot cry or laugh well. He grew up eating only colorful cubes of solidified nutrients, so he is said not to know even the joy of eating.
uncertain: [jp] subject restored as Emperor Galfa (as the one who taught him)

81.en: A top Gulfer executive who came to Earth as Subaru's guardian. Unlike the chips, his main body itself takes human form, so his combat power is high, and even in this form he has the power to wipe out the GEAR base.

82.en: A top Gulfer executive and aide to Gulfer Emperor who commands at the front lines in place of the emperor. He excels at melee combat and is good at staff fighting with an extendable staff (a nyoibo). He also has the terrifying special ability to revive immediately even when destroyed. He often travels, or performs combined attacks, riding on the back of the heavy machine beast Vector, which is capable of interstellar travel.
uncertain: [jp] rendered "extendable staff (a nyoibo)"

83.en: Zero's strongest form, combined with the heavy machine beast Vector. Armed with a giant lancer and the Photon Blasters fired from both shoulders, its combat power and mobility are both greatly powered up. Heavy machine beasts is a general term for machine beasts that earned promotions through achievements when Gulfer invaded other planets before conquering Earth; having gained experience, they are stronger individuals than ordinary machine beasts.
uncertain: "its" used because the combined form is a machine; Zero is "he" elsewhere

84.en: The king of the data weapons, born from the fusion of the revived Unicorn Drill and Leo Circle. It symbolizes "Friendship." It can transform into several forms: Kiba Striker, Kiba Breaker and Kiba Spinner. Because its performance exceeds that of the other data weapons, it is often used as a finishing move. Its attribute is "Wind" + "Whirl" = "Storm."

85.en: The chief designer who handles all the hardware of the Earth defense organization GEAR. After graduating from a top university he worked at a toy maker, but was recruited into GEAR for his outstanding design ability. He is surprisingly young at 31. He likes heroes, which explains why he gets along with Kirakuni. He collects ROGO blocks.
uncertain: Gender "he" from the glossary (cast-based)

86.en: A dragon-type data weapon that symbolizes "Compassion." It has a calm, hard-to-please personality, is learned, and tends to love solitude. It often materialized to fight. Its attribute is "Flame."

87.en: A cobra-type data weapon that symbolizes "Confidence." It is delicate and shrewd, the type whose true thoughts cannot be read. It is the best schemer among the data weapons. Data weapons also have the role of unlocking the sealed abilities of the Gears, and it is said that something will happen when all six data weapons are gathered. Its attribute is "Lightning."

88.en: A phoenix-type data weapon that symbolizes "Hope." Its attribute is "Rainbow." It had been hiding in Hokuto's head from the start, lending its power while borrowing the appearance of Vega as a young girl. The human brain, which transmits commands by electric signals, can also become a hiding place for data weapons. It can be made into a weapon for both Dendoh and Ogre at the same time. Also, because Dendoh has obtained all the data weapons, it can use Akatsuki's Great Sword, the ultimate evil-dispelling blade.
uncertain: [jp] rendered "Akatsuki's Great Sword"; Akatsuki here is the dawn/the name of the sword, not Nagare Akatsuki

89.en: A buffalo-type data weapon that symbolizes "Wisdom." It is usually quiet, but when angered it is out of control. It is the strongest of the data weapons. For some reason it was not used much. Its attribute is "Earth."

90.en: The deputy commander of the Earth defense organization GEAR. She hides her face behind a mask, and her true identity is kept secret even within GEAR. She was greatly involved in the founding of GEAR and is well versed in information about Dendoh and the data weapons. She was originally a candidate for Dendoh pilot, but since Hokuto and Ginga were chosen, her main duties became directing operations and supporting at the front lines using her dedicated bike, the Valkyrie. She also has astonishing physical ability, and is the only person who can fight Gulfer in person using the latest technology weapons developed by Dr. Inoue, such as beigoma bombs and the Measure. Usually she acts as a strict superior, but now and then she shows cute sides, such as making blunders or repairing her cracked mask with cellophane tape and using it.
uncertain: [jp] rendered "beigoma bombs" (beigoma = spinning tops)

92.en: A mysterious girl who seems to be deeply connected with Dendoh.

93.en: The giant computer that manages the GEAR headquarters. GEAR needs only a very small staff thanks to Meteo. It is powered by the Meteo Cube, a high-energy crystal from outside Earth.

94.en: A unicorn-type data weapon that symbolizes "Trust." It has a curious, friendly personality. Besides becoming a weapon or materializing, data weapons can also become "aliased," taking an astral form that has no physical interference with other objects. Unicorn Drill liked to alias and would slip out of the Gear Commander on its own to play. Its attribute is "Whirl."

95.en: The lord of Spiral Castle, sent to conquer Earth, who is called "Oyakata-sama." Under it are the three Machine Generals, and it is the apex of a pyramid that includes the machine beasts below them. Spiral Castle is a unit of the Gulfer army, and countless Spiral Castles exist throughout the universe.
uncertain: [jp] kept as "Oyakata-sama" (lord of the manor)

96.en: Gulfer Emperor's pet. It is not a machine life form but a space creature that eats machines. For that reason it is also used to punish subordinates who have failed. Hidden in Lagowe's huge jaws are fangs implanted with the Lagowe Virus, a computer virus that is deadly poison to machines.

97.en: A lion-type data weapon that symbolizes "Courage." It has an easygoing, slow-paced personality and often dozes off. It likes girls, becoming friends with Otome and helping with the e-mail exchanges with Yuki-chan of C-DRiVE. Its attribute is "Wind."

98.en: One of the former Nadesico crew and a Space Force lieutenant colonel, age 25. He is Yurika's childhood friend from her days on Earth and has been in love with her since he was a boy; during the Jovian War he served as Nadesico's assistant captain, but his feelings did not reach her. He is currently captain of the battleship Amaryllis of the Space Force 3rd Fleet and is on colony guard duty, and in the Shirahime Incident he witnessed Black Sarana boson out. He is capable at work but weak with women, so he has long been a plaything of the women. Incidentally, these days he is pushed around by Yukina every day.
uncertain: [jp] rendered "boson out" (emerging from a Boson Jump)
[jp] rendered "lieutenant colonel" (Wikipedia calls him Commander)
[jp] rendered "assistant captain"

99.en: Chairman of Nergal Heavy Industries, age 25. During the Jovian War, in order to monopolize Martian overtechnology, he boarded Nadesico under a concealed identity as a replacement pilot, and his ability as a pilot was ace class. His principle of action puts Nergal and himself first, and he does not choose his means to achieve his goals. After the war he disappeared from the public stage, but seems to have continued his activities behind the scenes with his specialty, covert operations.

100.en: Admiral of the United Space Force. He was a central figure in the Hot-Blooded Coup and opened the road to peace; he is an active Mokuren soldier but also holds a post in the Space Force as a goodwill ambassador. His personality is bold yet calm and cool-headed. He is a quite sharp man. During the Jovian War, he fought Nadesico as captain of the battleship Kannazuki of the Assault Yuto Space Corps.
uncertain: "he": gender from cast listings only (see glossary)
[jp] rendered "Admiral"; [jp] rendered "Assault Yuto Space Corps" (no English source)
[jp] rendered "Mokuren soldier"

101.en: Brigadier general of the Earth Alliance Unified Peacekeeping Forces. He is the person in charge of security at Amaterasu, the main terminal colony of the Hisago Plan. He is the type who cannot see his surroundings when he gets hot, and cannot really be called a capable commander. The Unified Forces is a military reorganized around the Mokuren forces and the Earth's army, navy and air forces; many people who felt cramped because the Space Force stole the leading role during the Jovian War belong to it, so relations with the Space Force are bad. Of course, Brigadier General Azuma also regards the Space Force as his enemy.
uncertain: "he": gender from cast listings only
[jp] rendered "Earth Alliance Unified Peacekeeping Forces" (Wikipedia says "Unified Forces")
[jp] rendered "Space Force" (UESF)

102.en: One of the three Aestivalis pilot girls of the old Nadesico, age 23. She is a born otaku girl who loves manga, anime and games, and does doujin activities as a hobby. She joined the military to draw realistic SF manga using her experience as a pilot. After the Jovian War she left the military and now has a serialization in a monthly magazine as a professional manga artist, but she seems to be drawing school stories, not SF. She has a cheerful, friendly personality, but a fairly hard past, such as being taken in by an uncle after her parents died.

103.name_jp: イネス・フレサンジュ
103.en: A brilliant woman, a survivor of the Nergal research facility on Mars, who handled the medical and science teams on the old Nadesico. She is also one of the few Class A Jumpers. In fact, she is the girl who was sent alone to Mars twenty years in the past when Akito made humanity's first Boson Jump during the First Battle of Mars, and she has a past of having been raised at a Nergal laboratory with her memory lost. After the Jovian War she was protected by Nergal, and she is officially registered as having died in an airplane accident. She loves to explain everything.
uncertain: The original is ambiguous about who made the jump and who was sent twenty years back; read as Akito jumped and Inez alone was sent

104.en: Chief mechanic of the old Nadesico, age 34. He was originally the owner of a small factory who did illegal modifications as a hobby, and his skill as a mechanic is first-rate. Garage kits, dioramas, hacking, inventions: he is a hobbyist with lopsided but diverse talents. After the Jovian War he returned to his old factory and lived with his wife. The scar on his cheek is from fighting yet again with the wife he left on Earth this time, and is not an old wound.

105.name_jp: エリナ・キンジョウ・ウォン
105.en: The chairman's secretary of Nergal Heavy Industries, who boarded the old Nadesico partway through as co-helmswoman, age 25. She is strongly career-oriented and tended to be at odds with the Nadesico crew. After the Jovian War she seems to have done various jobs as Akatsuki's right hand, and for a time she is said to have looked after Akito.
uncertain: [jp] rendered "co-helmswoman" (Wikipedia: co-helmswoman)

106.en: Nadesico's central computer. The name Omoikane is written with the kanji for "thinking" and "concurrent," and comes from the deity Omoikane-no-kami who appears in the Heavenly Rock Cave legend of Japanese mythology. Its official name is SVC2027. It has a kind of self-awareness, and is the super-high-performance computer that makes Nadesico a one-man-operation battleship. It has been with Ruri since the days of the old Nadesico, and has feelings resembling friendship toward her.

110.en: The leader of the Martian Successors. He was formerly the supreme commander of the Mokuren Yuto Corps with the rank of lieutenant general. He was the de facto leader during the Jovian War, but was expelled in the Hot-Blooded Coup and went missing. He seems to have been in contact with the Crimson Group since wartime and to have been preparing for an armed uprising beneath the surface. He is a hot-blooded man who loves justice and can die for his ideals, but he has the troublesome side of never doubting that his ideals are also ideals for others.

111.en: Former battle leader of Nadesico. He is an employee of Nergal Heavy Industries and was also the person in charge of the Schiaparelli Project, which aimed to retake the Mars ruins. After the Jovian War he belongs to the Nergal Secret Service, and is in charge of watching over and protecting the former Nadesico crew and intelligence work against rival companies. He is a taciturn and honest man, and it was he who rescued Akito from the Martian Successors' laboratory.

112.en: The younger sister of Tsukumo Shiratori, the hero of Mokuren who was assassinated at the peace talks. During the Jovian War she had so much initiative that she boarded Nadesico alone in order to assassinate Minato, who had misled her brother. After the war she was taken in by Minato, and is a 16-year-old current high-school girl attending school in Ooiso City. She belongs to the track team at school and is scheduled to compete in the summer inter-high. She has feelings for Jun, but does not seem to be conscious of him as a man yet.

114.name_jp: シンジョウ・アリトモ
114.en: Lieutenant colonel of the Unified Forces. He was in charge of the security of Amaterasu as Brigadier General Azuma's subordinate, but in reality he had the hidden face of being the number two of the Martian Successors, and deceived those around him.
uncertain: No pronoun needed in this entry; gender in glossary is cast-based

115.en: A lieutenant in the Unified Forces and one of the three Aestivalis pilot girls of the old Nadesico, age 23. She has quite a manly personality and calls herself "ore." She had feelings for Akito, but was shy about romance and could not tell him how she felt. At the time she had dyed her hair green, so at a glance she looks like a different person. After the war she transferred to the Unified Forces and serves as a pilot instructor and Aestivalis squadron leader, and has trained many excellent subordinates.
uncertain: [jp] kept as the romanized pronoun "ore" in quotes

116.name_jp: タカスギ・サブロウタ
116.en: A captain of the United Space Force and the first officer of Nadesico B, age 25. He also commands in combat, flying a Super Aestivalis. He is a former Mokuren soldier and served as first officer of the battleship Kannazuki during the Jovian War. Now he looks like a flirty, flippant guy, but at that time he was a straightforward young man; it is said that when he guarded Ruri on Akiyama's special orders after the war, he disguised himself as a surfer and ended up picking up a light attitude.
uncertain: [jp] rendered "captain" (Wikipedia calls him First Lieutenant; Japanese rank [jp] corresponds to captain/lieutenant)
The final clause "he ... picked up a light attitude" restores the subject Saburota (original has no subject)

117.en: One of the few Class A Jumpers, age 23. A A-Class Jumper refers to a person capable of solo biological Boson Jump, and is an indispensable talent for controlling jumps. Akito is Yurika's childhood friend from her days on Mars, and served as both an Aestivalis pilot and a cook on the old Nadesico. After the war he opened a ramen stall, and seems to have lived in a tenement with Yurika and Ruri, the three of them. After that, following a ramen contest with Koichiro Misumaru, he married Yurika. On their honeymoon he was thought to have died in a shuttle accident, but in fact the two had been abducted by the Martian Successors, and in the human experiments on Boson Jump, Akito lost most of his five senses. He was later rescued by the Nergal Secret Service, but because he could not take Yurika back, he is now operating covertly to retake Yurika and take revenge on the Martian Successors, with Nergal's support. He gives off a cold, cool air, and seems a different person from the indecisive, naive youth of the old Nadesico days.
uncertain: [jp] rendered "shuttle accident"

118.en: Helmswoman of the old Nadesico, age 27. She was originally a beautiful secretary at a major company, but boarded Nadesico in search of fulfillment. A woman who is not only alluring but also highly intelligent and tolerant, she fell in love with Tsukumo Shiratori of Mokuren and served as a bridge between Earth and Mokuren. After the war she took in Yukina, who had lost her family, and teaches mathematics in Ooiso City.

119.en: One of the former Nadesico crew, dispatched from Nergal as supervisor and auditor. He is also the person who selected the old Nadesico crew. His age and real name are both unknown, and Prospector is something like a pen name. Incidentally, it means a miner or test driller. Near the end of the Jovian War he turned against Nergal, but he returned to Nergal after the war. Belonging to the chairman's secretary section, he is active mainly in information gathering.

120.en: The leader of the assassination unit directly under Kusakabe. He can be called the dark side of the Martian Successors, and specializes in dirty work such as kidnapping and murder. He is a cold, ruthless man who thinks nothing of killing his comrades for a mission. Incidentally, his left eye is a prosthetic eye.

121.en: Members of the assassination unit led by Hokushin.
uncertain: [jp] rendered "Hokushin's Six" (Hokushin's Six per the English dub credits; the game name carries no number)

127.en: Captain of Nadesico B, famous as the youngest-ever genius beautiful girl captain. She is 16 and holds the rank of major. She is a master of computer operation, with the nickname Electronic Fairy. She is a girl created by prohibited genetic manipulation, and at age 11 she served as the operator of the old Nadesico. Before boarding the old Nadesico she had almost no memories except for education, so the memories of that time are important to her. After the war she lived with Yurika and Akito, but because the two had an accident, she was taken in by Minato. At that time she met Takasugi and recovered from the memory of the accident, returned to the Space Force, solved numerous difficult cases, and has come to the present.
uncertain: [jp]: "Haruka" here is Minato Haruka's family name; rendered "Minato"
[jp] rendered "major" (Wikipedia: Lieutenant Commander)
Subject of "met Takasugi / recovered / returned" is Ruri (restored)

128.en: One of the three Aestivalis pilot girls of the old Nadesico, age 23. She is an eccentric whose specialties are chilly puns and the ukulele, and her parents seem to have been comedians. Having been left behind by her fiances twice through death, she seems to have thought of herself as a woman who brings misfortune. After the war she wandered the world learning various martial arts and polishing her bizarre sense of humor. Having saved the owner from thugs on her travels, she seems to have become the hired mama-san of the bar "Kemeko."
uncertain: [jp]: rendered "left behind by her fiances twice through death"; the original does not say if the two were the same man
[jp] rendered "Kemeko"

129.en: An ensign of the United Space Force and the assistant first officer of Nadesico B, age 11. Like Ruri, he is a boy born through Nergal's genetic manipulation, and has excellent operation ability. Reflecting on how Ruri was raised, he was placed with an ordinary family from early childhood, and seems to have grown into a bright boy with rich emotional expression. He adores Ruri, who is close in age and similar in background, as an older sister, and Ruri also seems to think of him as a younger brother; the nickname Harry was given by her.
uncertain: [jp] rendered "Harry"

130.name_jp: ミスマル・コウイチロウ
130.en: Commander-in-chief of the Earth Alliance Space Force. He was an admiral during the Jovian War, but seems to have risen in rank. He is Yurika's father and a doting father to the extreme. Basically he is a capable soldier, but when it comes to Yurika he has the bad habit of putting personal feelings first. Naturally he was strongly opposed to her marriage to Akito. Also, his habit of reciting strange senryu and haiku does not seem to have been cured.
uncertain: [jp] rendered "Earth Alliance Space Force" in this entry; elsewhere "United Space Force" (UESF)

131.en: Captain of the old Nadesico, age 25. She is also one of the Class A Jumpers. A sheltered daughter whose father is commander-in-chief of the United Space Force, she has a fairly carefree personality but is a genius at strategy simulation. She kept waiting for Akito, whom she fell in love with as a small child, and even after they met again on the old Nadesico, she never doubted that Akito loved her very much. Near the end of the Jovian War she made the decision to discard the Mars ruins into the far reaches of space, and as a result the two armies, having lost the purpose of the war, headed toward a truce. In a sense she is the one who deserves credit for ending the war. After the war she stayed in the military while helping at Akito's stall, and happily got married, but on their honeymoon she was abducted by the Martian Successors and used as a human translator for Boson Jumps, joined to the ruins in a state of suspended animation.
uncertain: [jp] rendered "United Space Force"

132.en: Communications officer of the old Nadesico, age 22. She originally worked as a voice actress, and seems to have been scouted for her beautiful voice. While aboard the old Nadesico she rivaled Yurika over Akito, and even came close to eloping. After the war she returned to voice acting and has become a hugely popular idol active in songs and radio, and is called by the nicknames "Megu-nee" and "Megu-tan."
uncertain: [jp] rendered "Megu-nee" / "Megu-tan"
[jp] rendered "came close to eloping"; the partner is not named in the text (presumably Akito)

133.en: Deputy director of the Colony Development Corporation, posted at Amaterasu. In reality, however, he is a member of the Martian Successors and a scientist who serves as the chief of Boson Jump research. He is a nonchalant, elusive man, and quite a character.
uncertain: "he": gender from cast listings only
[jp] rendered "deputy director"

134.en: A girl created through genetic manipulation like Ruri. She also has excellent operation ability. She was originally raised at a Nergal laboratory, but was captured by the Martian Successors and later rescued by Akito. Since then she has acted together with Akito, who lost his five senses, as his support. The battleship Eucharis that she operates is the mothership of Black Sarana. She lacks emotional expression even more than Ruri used to, and is a mysterious girl.
uncertain: [jp] rendered "Eucharis" (Wikipedia/Nadesico fandom); kana is Yuchalis

255.en: A 15-year-old junior high school student who is thrown into a mad battle regardless of his own will. He lived a comfortable life without any connection to Tekkoryu, but he holds faint memories and knowledge about Zeorymer in his subconscious, and can pilot Zeorymer unconsciously. He is a shy, ordinary boy, with a gentle side that refuses to make sacrifices and cannot be ruthless. However, he has a duality in which his personality changes to a vicious one during combat; he fears this self and suffers in agony. When his personality becomes vicious, his gaze sharpens and the color of his eyes changes. Zeorymer piloted in this state displays its true power, and keeps the other Hakke robots at bay with overwhelming attack power and high-speed movement.

258.en: The central figure of the Zeorymer awakening project. A person from the Japanese government who has been deeply involved since Zeorymer was placed under its control. He knows the secret of Masato's birth, and leads Masato Akitsu to Last Guardian. He is calm and composed, does not defy orders from above, and carries out his missions reliably. In combat he gives accurate instructions, but not out of concern for Masato; they are strictly for the sake of the Japanese government. He always wears sunglasses and does not show his true feelings.

259.en: One of the Hakkeshu and the pilot of Burrstone of the Mountains. Read "Giso." He is a quiet man who secretly loves Rockfell but never says it aloud. A typical warrior, he respects Yuratei. Although he senses signs of treason from Saiga, out of consideration for Rockfell's feelings he cannot bring himself to tell Yuratei.
uncertain: [jp]: the reading note kept as "Read Gisou" (the game spells the name with an uncommon kanji)

261.en: The creator of Masato Akitsu, Miku Himuro and the Hakkeshu. Fifteen years ago, the original Masaki Kihara was an engineer of Tekkoryu, but he fled taking Zeorymer, and immediately afterward was killed by the Japanese government, which feared his defecting. However, he had set into the fertilized egg of his clone Masato that Masaki's personality would awaken when Masato rides Zeorymer, and so he achieves resurrection. The reason Zeorymer can be moved only by Masato and Masaki is that the genes of Masato's fertilized egg were input to the pilot registration system. As an engineer he is a genius, showing talent not only in bioengineering but also in mechanical engineering, and he built the Dimensional Coupler System. He is cruel and cunning, and does not hesitate to sacrifice others for his own aims. His goal is to become the King of the Underworld himself, and having calculated that either the Japanese government or Tekkoryu would rule the world, he left a clone of himself with both of them.
uncertain: [jp] rendered "feared his defecting" (feared he would defect abroad)
[jp] rendered "Dimensional Coupler System" (SRW wiki)

262.en: One of the Hakkeshu and the pilot of Omzack of the Lightning. Read "Saiga." He belittles Yuratei, and is an outlier among the Hakkeshu in conduct and personality. He speaks with confidence and looks down on others somehow. He is a cold-hearted ambitious man who thinks of taking control of the world, and to that end uses Rockfell's love while knowing of it.
uncertain: "he": gender from cast listings only

263.en: A female warrior of the Hakkeshu who pilots Briest of the Fires. She has a twin younger sister, Shi-Tau, in the same Hakkeshu. A martial arts master, she has higher ability as a warrior than Tau, so in combat she gives orders to Tau. She is calm and composed, and loves Tau more than anyone, but her feelings do not reach Tau.

264.en: A female warrior of the Hakkeshu who pilots Gallowin of the Waters. She feels a fierce inferiority complex about the difference in talent from her twin older sister Shi-Aen, and is dissatisfied about being assigned a support role even in combat. Her emotions swing wildly, and she dislikes her appearance being just like her sister's, so she gets furiously angry when she is compared with her sister.

265.en: One of the Hakkeshu and the pilot of Lanstar of the Winds. Read "Taiha." He and Yuratei are lovers, but he feels frustrated by a love that cannot be fully rewarded. To make others acknowledge that he is a man worthy of loving Yuratei, and to prove that he is the strongest warrior of the Hakkeshu, he volunteered as the first assassin to retake Zeorymer. He has a warm heart and is the type who charges straight toward his goal. He fought speaking of his feelings for Yuratei to the end, but fell before the "Hades Attack." Also, each member of the Hakkeshu has a tattoo on the palm of the hand that represents his or her title.
uncertain: [jp] rendered "lovers"; [jp] rendered "a love that cannot be fully rewarded"
[jp] bearers "his or her" because the Hakkeshu include women

266.en: A girl destined to ride Zeorymer together with Masato Akitsu. When aboard Zeorymer she seems to become the sub-pilot who controls the data, and boards from Zeorymer's chest light sphere. She has accepted her fate and was preparing at Last Guardian for the fight against Tekkoryu. To make Masato, whom she meets for the first time, resolve to fight, she speaks cool, cold words, but inside she is kind and cares for others. Also, she has superhuman physical ability and a tough body, and is a girl with many mysteries.

267.en: The 20-year-old emperor of Tekkoryu, a giant society plotting world domination. Tekkoryu, known by the nickname Hau Dragon, lay hidden underground for fifteen years behind the hardware company International Electronic Brains, but began to act as soon as the Hakke robots were completed, and is carrying out the Hades Project to turn the world into the underworld and reign as the King of the Underworld herself. Before being chosen as emperor she was one of the Hakkeshu and was supposed to become Zeorymer's pilot. She and Taiha love each other, but because of her position as emperor she cannot love him as a single man. In front of others she behaves with the dignity of an emperor, but she also has womanly weakness, and when Taiha sortied she was crying in her room, holding back her voice.
uncertain: [jp] rendered "reign as the King of the Underworld"; the game uses [jp] (Hades/Meioh) for both the project and the title
[jp] rendered "emperor"; Wikipedia says "Empress" for this female ruler

268.en: One of the Hakkeshu and a masked warrior who pilots Rose C'est La Vie of the Moon. Read "Ritsu." He gives off a cool, cold air, but inside him swirls an abnormal obsession and hatred toward Zeorymer. Under the mask is the face of a beautiful woman, and that is a trauma for him, who wants to be more manly than anyone. He was the first to learn the secret of his own birth and tried to go against his own fate.
uncertain: Gender "he" stated in the text ([jp])

269.en: The Tekkoryu engineer who developed the Hakke robots. Fifteen years ago, Luhran plotted world conquest using Tekkoryu together with Masaki Kihara, but gave it up because of Masaki's betrayal. Luhran is obsessed with defeating Zeorymer and seems to know the mystery of Zeorymer's energy system. Luhran is timid, but the type who says what needs to be said.
uncertain: No pronoun used: gender of Rularn is not established by a prose source (male by cast only)
[jp] rendered "timid, but the type who says what needs to be said"

270.en: A sturdy female warrior of the Hakkeshu who pilots Dinodilos of the Earth. She secretly has feelings for Saiga. For that reason, although she respects and bows to Yuratei, her heart is moved by Saiga's ambition. She is passionate, and because of her strong will, even when she learns that she is being used, she ends up shielding Saiga.

345.en: A formerly excellent soldier of the Mokuren Assault Yuto Space Corps. A user of Mokuren-style jujutsu. In the days of the Jovian War he fought Nadesico A several times together with Tsukumo Shiratori. But he fell into Haruki Kusakabe's scheme and assassinated Tsukumo at the peace talks between Mokuren and Earth. Regretting that, he later wrote a manifesto beginning with "Hot-bloodedness is not blind faith" and carried out the "Hot-Blooded Coup" within Mokuren together with Genpachiro Akiyama. In the course of it he disappeared. After that, he was picked up by Nergal Heavy Industries and, as a member of the Nergal Secret Service, probed the movements of the Martian Successors. Also, together with Goat, he rescued Akito Tenkawa from the Martian Successors and gave him rehabilitation and training in piloting mobile weapons.
uncertain: [jp] rendered "manifesto"
[jp] rendered "Hot-bloodedness is not blind faith"
[jp] ("he disappeared") subject restored as Tsukiomi

396.en: Former head cook of Nadesico A. She used spices from around the world with mastery, and for Akito Tenkawa in the Nadesico A days she was something like a teacher. After the end of the Jovian War she opened a diner called "Hibi Heion," which is reputed to have a rich menu starting with the Martian Rice Bowl.
uncertain: [jp] rendered "Hibi Heion"; [jp] rendered "Mars bowl"
[jp] rendered "Houmei" (Howmei in the English dub)

23.en: An operator attached to the NERV Headquarters Central Command Room, in charge of communications and information analysis. When the Strategic Self-Defense Force attacked NERV Headquarters, he encouraged Maya and returned fire with a gun; despite his breezy way of speaking, he also has a gutsy side. His hobby is the guitar.

24.en: Belongs to Technical Section 1 of the Technology Development Department at NERV Headquarters. She is the daughter of Dr. Naoko Akagi, who built the basic theory of the supercomputer MAGI, and the person in charge of Project E, the Evangelion development project. She has a cool personality, and when faced with the facts she can take a cold attitude toward others. She has been Misato's close friend since their university days. In contrast to her cool personality, her hobby is collecting cat trinkets, and she keeps cats at her family home as well.
uncertain: '[jp]' (family home) rendered 'her family home' without specifying parents.

25.en: The pilot of EVA-00. The First Child, the first pilot of the Evangelion series. Her entire background is a mystery, and she is a quiet girl who does not show her emotions. She herself says that her reason for riding an Eva is "bonds." She holds special feelings for Gendo, and treasures his glasses, which broke when he rescued her from the entry plug at the risk of his own body during the Unit-00 experiment. The secret she hides is closely tied to the making of the Evangelion series and to Gendo's aims.
uncertain: 'Gendo's glasses': 'broke when he rescued her' - subject of the rescue is Gendo (the text says Gendo's glasses broke when he put his body on the line).

26.en: The Supreme Commander of the special agency NERV. His background includes being the former director of the Artificial Evolution Laboratory and the former director of Gehirn. Having received the duty of investigating and annihilating the Angels, he has also been entrusted single-handedly with carrying out the Human Instrumentality Project. He is a cold man who will use any means to achieve his goal, and he always takes an overbearing attitude toward other people. This extends even to his own subordinates and his son; the only exception is toward Rei Ayanami. The Human Instrumentality Project he envisions is different from SEELE's plan, and in the end he becomes SEELE's enemy.
uncertain: 'Artificial Evolution Laboratory' is a literal rendering ([jp]); no English source found.

27.en: The pilot of EVA-01. The Third Child, selected by the Marduk Institute. He lost his mother in early childhood and had lived apart from his father Gendo for more than ten years, but was called to Tokyo-3 when the Angels began to arrive. He is introverted and not very good at communicating with other people. At first he rode the Eva out of a sense of duty, but he comes to find the meaning of riding it through the fighting. As he comes into contact with the people of NERV and the boys and girls around him, he gradually opens his heart, but he is also hurt by the incidents that arise during the battles. His special skill is playing the cello.

29.en: Ritsuko's subordinate, belonging to Technical Section 1 of the Technology Department at NERV Headquarters. She is an operator at the NERV Headquarters Central Operations Command who monitors the Eva pilots. She respects her superior Ritsuko. Because she is a fastidious perfectionist, she loathes things like Gendo's way of using any means to achieve his aims.
uncertain: 'Technology Department' ([jp]) vs. Ritsuko's 'Technology Development Department' ([jp]): kept distinct as in the Japanese.

30.en: A member of the secret organization that plans the Human Instrumentality Project.

31.en: A member of the secret organization that plans the Human Instrumentality Project.

34.en: A young man who belongs to NERV's Special Inspection Department. He came to Japan from the German Branch to bring Asuka, Unit-02 and a mysterious object called Adam. In fact he was a triple spy working for NERV, SEELE and the Ministry of the Interior of the Japanese government, but he is assassinated by someone, perhaps because his identity was exposed. He seems a frivolous man who calls out to women he likes, but he is an object of admiration for Asuka, and a caring older-brother type to those younger than himself. His hobby is growing watermelons. Incidentally, he and Misato were lovers in their student days.
uncertain: 'Special Inspection Department' ([jp]) is a literal rendering; the eva wiki calls his post 'Special Inspector'.

35.en: Belongs to Section 1 of the Operations Bureau, Tactical Operations Department, at NERV Headquarters. Her rank is captain at first (later promoted to major). Her main duties are planning operations for battles with the Angels and commanding those operations. She happened to be at the site of Second Impact in her childhood and lost her father then, so she bears a grudge against the Angels and joined NERV. On the surface she is a cheerful, sloppy and friendly big-sister type who lives with Shinji and gradually opens his heart. However, she herself carries several old wounds inside. She has been Ritsuko's close friend since university, and Kaji was her lover while they were at university. She loves beer and sometimes drinks from the middle of the day, and keeps a hot-spring penguin, Pen Pen, as a pet.
uncertain: Ranks: game says [jp] then [jp]; rendered captain / major as in the eva wiki.

36.en: A central figure of the Human Instrumentality Committee and of SEELE. He apparently has known Gendo for a long time. He always wears a visor, and his true face has not been revealed.

37.en: Shinji's classmate. A hot-blooded Kansai-dialect speaker and a caring older brother to his little sister. At first, because his little sister was injured in an Eva battle, he took out his anger on Shinji by unfairly blaming him, but he reflected when he saw Shinji earnestly fighting the Angels. After that he became friends with Shinji, along with Kensuke. Later the Marduk Institute selected him as the Fourth Child, and he came to ride EVA-03. However, during its activation test an Angel took it over, Unit-03 was defeated by Unit-01 using the Dummy Plug, and Toji himself was seriously injured.

38.en: A secret organization that plans the Human Instrumentality Project. Its members appear to the outside world only as monolith-shaped holograms and voices.

39.name_jp: 惣流・アスカ・ラングレー
39.en: The pilot of EVA-02. The Second Child, selected by the Marduk Institute. She is one-quarter Japanese, with German blood as well, and is a genius girl who graduated from university at 14. She is proud and has absolute confidence in her own ability. For that reason she takes a condescending attitude toward other people, especially boys her own age. That attitude apparently stems from the fact that her mother was involved in Eva experiments and killed herself after being mentally contaminated. She can find her own worth only as an Eva pilot, and when that identity is lost, her mind begins to collapse.
uncertain: '[jp]' rendered 'one-quarter Japanese, with German blood as well' (eva wiki: one-quarter Japanese; German-Japanese mother).

41.en: An entry plug developed so that an Evangelion can be operated without a pilot. Some kind of personality seems to have been implanted in it, and it works as a dummy for the pilot with respect to the Eva.

42.en: The fifth Angel to be confirmed. It has an octahedral exterior and attacks approaching enemies with a powerful charged particle cannon. To defeat this Angel, NERV used a modified positron cannon for Evas (NERV specification), which required power supplied from all over Japan.

43.en: The thirteenth Angel to be confirmed. Lurking inside a cumulonimbus cloud, it made contact with EVA-03, which was being transported to NERV's Second Experimental Site in Matsushiro, and immediately after the activation test it completely took over Unit-03 with Toji still inside, whereupon it was recognized as an Angel. It went as far as defeating Unit-00 and Unit-02, but was destroyed by Unit-01, which had activated the Dummy System.

44.en: The fourteenth Angel to be confirmed. It invaded the Geofront from Tokyo-3 and, with overwhelming attack power surpassing any previous Angel, defeated Unit-02 and Unit-00. In the end it fought the berserk Unit-01 and was eaten.

45.en: The Fifth Child, dispatched by SEELE. His background, like Rei Ayanami's, is entirely unknown. He has a startling ability to change his synchronization rate at will, which astonished the NERV staff. He actively approached Shinji, and Shinji opened his heart to his straightforwardness and kindness. However, he was in fact the 17th Angel Tabris, sent in by SEELE, and he entered Terminal Dogma with the unmanned Unit-02 in tow. In the end, at his own wish, he was crushed by Unit-01, which Shinji was riding. He loved songs and hummed Beethoven's Ninth.

46.en: Belongs to Section 1 of the Operations Bureau at the NERV Headquarters Central Operations Command. He assists Misato in planning operations and handles operator duties such as analyzing the battle situation inside the base. He has feelings for Misato that go beyond those toward a mere superior, and he obtains top-secret information for her without caring that his own position may be endangered because of it.

47.en: The Deputy Commander of NERV. Always calm and composed, and a bit of a cynic. He has known Gendo since the time he was serving as an assistant professor at a university. His first impression of Gendo when they first met was "an unpleasant man," but after Second Impact he became Gendo's collaborator. At times he voices negative opinions to Gendo, but he is one of the few people who understand Gendo's aims.

48.en: Shinji and the others' classmate and the class representative. A model student whose nickname is also "Class Rep." She secretly has feelings for Toji, and promises to make a lunch box and bring it to Toji, who eats bread bought at the school store for lunch. However, because of the Unit-03 incident, this promise was never fulfilled in the original work. Incidentally, she was apparently drawn to Toji's "kindness." She also has an older sister named Kodama and a younger sister named Nozomi.
uncertain: Nickname 'Class Rep' renders [jp] (iinchou).

49.en: The Evangelion series that SEELE, the secret organization managing the Human Instrumentality Project, sent to NERV Headquarters to stop Gendo, who was advancing his own plan outside its schedule. There are nine in all. Unlike the series up to then, their specifications include flight ability and the S2 Engine as standard equipment. Dummy Plugs are used to activate and operate them, and those seem to contain Kaworu Nagisa's data.

166.en: A civilian boy who lived in Green Noa 1, a colony in Side 7. His hobbies include karate, piloting the Homo Abyss (a one-person small aircraft), and piloting junior mobile suits. He has a strong complex about his feminine-sounding name, and when he punched Jerid for laughing at it, he was taken away by the Titans. After that, through his contact with Quattro, who had infiltrated Green Noa, he joined the AEUG. On that occasion he put up a fight in the Gundam Mk-II, which he was riding for the first time, a performance that made Bright and the others call him "the return of Amuro Ray." After joining the AEUG he continued to achieve great results, and with the blossoming of his Newtype ability he played an ace-class role. He also showed outstanding talent in mobile suit development, and the Mk-II's flying armor and the Zeta Gundam incorporate his ideas. His personality is a complex one in which sensitivity and ferocity, boyish honesty and calculating streaks coexist. At first he joined the fighting out of a vague anger at the Titans, but through his encounters with Quattro, Amuro and Four, he came to fight by his own will in order to bring the war to an end, and grew greatly as a person. He wins the decisive battle against Scirocco on the Colony Laser, but is driven to a mental breakdown. Afterward he spends a life of recuperation with Fa, but in "Mobile Suit Gundam ZZ" he guides Judau and Ple several times. He recovers in the final episode of that work.
uncertain: 'Homo Abyss' is an unverified rendering of [jp].
'Jerid' and 'Four' are used as short names (Jerid Messa, Four Murasame).

167.en: The leader of the Argama's mobile suit team. His rank is captain, but he is an important AEUG figure who not only fights as a pilot in the Rick Dias and the Hyaku Shiki but also gives his opinion on strategy. He habitually wears sunglasses, and there is much that is mysterious about his words and actions and his past. His true identity is Char Aznable, the Red Comet of Zeon, who was sent from Axis to scout the state of the Earth sphere. He noticed Kamille's Newtype potential early on and looked after him in various ways. At first he concentrated on being a pilot in order to fight the Titans, who threatened the position of the Spacenoids, but through his reunion with his former rival Amuro, the appearance of Scirocco, Blex's death and the speech at Dakar, he becomes a central figure of the AEUG. But after the battle with Haman's Qubeley at the Colony Laser, he goes missing. After that, Char never used the name Quattro again. Incidentally, quattro is the Italian word for the number 4, and it means the fourth name, following Casval, Edouard and Char.

168.en: A member of the Argama's bridge crew. He is in charge of deck command, communications and search. Partly because they were close in age, he was on friendly terms with Kamille. In "Mobile Suit Gundam ZZ," due to a shortage of hands, there were scenes where he served as a pilot, and even after Judau and the others moved to the Nahel Argama he continued to serve aboard and assisted Beecha, who became acting captain.

169.en: A girl who lived next door to Kamille's home in Green Noa 1. After her parents were captured by the Titans, she joined the AEUG and became a pilot. While in Green Noa 1, out of goodwill she wanted to look after Kamille in various ways, but after joining the AEUG she came to rely on Kamille out of anxiety and fear. And because she wanted Kamille to acknowledge her, she pushed herself too hard as a pilot many times. In order to nurse Kamille, whose mind collapsed in the final battle with Scirocco, she leaves the Argama early in "Mobile Suit Gundam ZZ."

170.en: One of the junk dealer friends of Shangri-La and Judau's best friend. He is good with machines and was active not only as a pilot but also as a mechanic and as bridge crew. He has an honest personality and is a little timid, but he speaks up for his own opinion when he should, and sometimes took brave action for his friends. In the original work he also showed himself in drag along with Judau.

171.en: A woman who serves as acting captain of Anaheim's supply ship La Vie en Rose. Normally she is a capable commander who handles supply and other matters efficiently, but she has feelings for Bright that go beyond fondness, and she shows girlish bashfulness in front of him. In order to protect the Nahel Argama, she used La Vie en Rose as a shield and lost her life.

172.en: One of the junk dealer friends of Shangri-La. Within the group she was mainly in charge of gathering information. Her personality is lively and spirited, and she was a quarreling friend of Judau, but inwardly she had feelings for him. After boarding the Argama, she burned with rivalry toward Roux and fought mainly in the Gundam Mk-II. In the course of the fighting she shows a girlish side in front of Judau several times, but in the end she responds to Beecha's feelings.

173.en: A girl who had been adjusted as a Newtype pilot at Axis. She took to Judau at first sight, and after Glemy's mind control was released, she became a member of the Argama. Her favorite food is chocolate parfait, and she loves baths too. Her everyday life is that of a young girl, and she often troubled Judau and the others with childlike selfishness and possessiveness. But deep inside, she was filled with the loneliness of having been raised as a warrior. Feeling responsible for Leina going missing, she tries to be an emotional support for Judau, but loses her life in the battle with Ple Two.
uncertain: Short name 'Ple' used per the glossary (the English LP spells it 'Puru').

174.en: A civilian boy who lived in Shangri-La, a colony in Side 1. He supported himself and his younger sister Leina by working as a junk dealer. He tried to steal a mobile suit from the Argama when it docked, but through circumstance and his innate sense of justice, he drove off Yazan and Neo Zeon in the Zeta Gundam, and this led to his becoming a pilot belonging to the Argama. He is full of drive and vitality, with a constantly bright, positive personality. He fought for his friends and Leina, but as his friends and Leina were drawn into the fighting, he came to have a clear will to fight to end the war. He has high potential as a Newtype as well, and connected hearts with Haman, Ple and others. After winning the decisive battle with Haman, he joins the Jupiter Energy Fleet with Roux for further growth.

175.en: One of the junk dealer friends of Shangri-La and the leader type among Judau and his group. However, because of his opportunistic and selfish personality, he is not trusted very much by his friends and often clashed with Judau. At one point, judging the situation, he considered siding with Neo Zeon together with Mondo, but in the end he returned to the Argama and fought mainly as the Hyaku Shiki's pilot. After Bright withdrew from the front, he held his friends together as captain of the Nahel Argama.

176.en: Ple's twin younger sister. She received even heavier mind control than Ple, and her personality is also more aggressive. Fighting as Glemy ordered, she takes Ple's life, but through meeting Judau she comes to doubt her own actions. In the final battle at Axis, riding the Quin Mantha, she finally leaves Glemy's side, also guided by Ple's soul. But her mind and body were already at their limit, and she gives out after guiding the escape of Judau, who had won the decisive battle with Haman.
uncertain: 'Quin Mantha' is the Gundam wiki/standard spelling of [jp].

177.en: One of the junk dealer friends of Shangri-La. He gets along especially well with Beecha, and at one point they tried to leave the Argama together. Boasting outstanding mechanic's sense, he was active in the colony Moon Moon, for example by repairing an abandoned work mobile suit, a Catl. He was opportunistic by nature at first, but he grew as a person after meeting Rasara, the leader of Moon Moon.

178.en: Judau's younger sister. A kind-hearted girl who always worried about Judau, who ran a junk business, even while nagging him. After boarding the Argama she was in charge of cooking, laundry and the like, but by chance she was taken under Glemy's protection, and after that she received an education as a lady. When Neo Zeon occupied Dakar, she was shot by Haman while shielding Judau, and was further caught up in the fighting and went missing with her fate unknown. However, after all the battles are over, she is reunited with Judau safely thanks to Sayla Mass.

179.en: A volunteer soldier of the AEUG who transported the ZZ Gundam's Core Fighter to the Argama. Her trademark is a pilot suit with a meteor marking. After Judau started riding the ZZ Gundam, she served as the Zeta Gundam's pilot. She has a strong-minded personality with a clear will of her own, and at times she clashed with Judau and the others, who were fighting by circumstance, but she gradually came to get along with them as comrades. She was also bewildered by Glemy Toto's one-sided advances, but when she shot him in the decisive battle at Axis, she wept alone. After all the battles are over, she joins the Jupiter Energy Fleet with Judau.

180.en: The captain who leads the mobile suit unit of the Londo Bell unit. In the One Year War he piloted the RX-78 Gundam, left record-setting results, and at the same time made the Federation aware of the real existence of Newtypes. After the war, however, he was forced to live under house arrest by the Earth Federation, which feared his power. Afterward he joined Karaba, the AEUG's support organization, and served as leader of its mobile suit unit. After the First Neo Zeon War he belonged to Londo Bell, the Federation Forces' external independent unit, and fought the Neo Zeon forces led by his archrival Char Aznable, who was advancing the Earth cooling operation. At the time of the One Year War he was a nervous boy in whom sensitivity and dependence coexisted, but through his encounters during the war he awakened as a Newtype, and through various experiences he grew greatly as a person. After stopping Axis from falling to Earth in the Second Neo Zeon War, he goes missing together with his beloved Nu Gundam, which he himself took part in designing, and with Char.
uncertain: 'Earth cooling operation' ([jp]) is a literal rendering.
