181.en: A technical officer of the Earth Federation Forces who is in charge of adjusting the Nu Gundam. She has feelings for her superior Amuro, and burns with extraordinary enthusiasm for adjusting the psycho-frame so as to be of help to him. During the battle at Axis, thinking that even a little would add to his strength, she tries to deliver a psycho-frame sample to Amuro and goes onto the battlefield in a half-destroyed Re-GZ. Then she cuts in between Hathaway and Quess and shoots down the Alpha Azieru, but she is shot and killed by Hathaway, who has flown into a rage over Quess being killed.

182.en: He served as captain of the White Base in the One Year War, as captain of the Argama in the AEUG, and as captain of the flagship Ra Cailum in Londo Bell as well. He has decisiveness and judgment based on abundant combat experience.

282.en: Ayato's classmate. She is going out with Mamoru Torigai but casts meaningful glances at Ayato. She always acts cheerful, such as by teasing Ayato, but she is the type to keep her true feelings to herself. On the subway heading to the mock exam site, she was caught up, together with Ayato and Mamoru, in a derailment caused by Operation Overlord.

283.en: An Earth Federation inspector sent to TERRA. 29 years old. His name is read "Isshiki Makoto" (family name first). His career is unknown in detail and wrapped in mystery. He has known Itsuki Kisaragi since childhood, but they are not on good terms. He is ambitious and repeatedly speaks and acts as if looking down on others, and he especially said harsh words to Ayato. He has no hesitation about treating people as tools and can betray others without a second thought. He will use any means to gather information, and exploited the feelings of Sayoko Nanamori, who has feelings for Itsuki Kisaragi. TERRA staff privately gave him the nickname "White Snake."
uncertain: The 'read as ...' note keeps the Japanese-order name; the English name order is Makoto Isshiki.

284.en: Ayato's classmate. He is Hiroko Asahina's boyfriend and Ayato's best friend. He has a light-hearted personality and is good at cracking jokes and playing the fool, but he is always shot down by Hiroko. Together with Ayato and Hiroko, he was caught up in a derailment caused by Operation Overlord on the subway heading to the mock exam site.

285.name_jp: エルフィ・ハディヤット
285.en: An ace pilot belonging to the Federation. 27 years old. She was the only survivor of Operation Overlord, and when she learned that the real objective had been to seize Ayato, she vented her anger on Haruka. At first she disliked Ayato because her comrades had been wiped out in an operation whose only purpose was to seize him, but she gradually warmed to him. Transferred from the Federation to the TERRA air wing, she organized Alpha Squadron together with her former comrades and serves as its leader. She has the Indonesian nickname "Bunga Mawar" (a rose). She is bold, but because she cares about her subordinates she was adored by the Alpha Squadron members. As a soldier she dislikes naive thinking about the Mu, and she doubts the wisdom of making a child, Ayato, fight. At the same time, however, she agonizes over her raison d'etre as a professional soldier. She is a bit of a bad drunk, and after drinking with Haruka she often picks on Ayato.
uncertain: 'MU' here is rendered 'the Mu' (the Mulians' civilization/forces).

286.name_jp: エルンスト・フォン・バーベム
286.en: The head of the Bahbem Foundation. His age is unknown. He gives TERRA financial aid and technical support, and is a powerful figure who can apply pressure even to the Federation. He lives on Karun Mutiana Island. The foundation's predecessor, the Naacal Trading Company, was founded in 1576, but the first head's name and appearance are the same as the current Bahbem's. With technology applying excavated OOPArts and the patents for it, he controls the world economy from behind the scenes, a mysterious old man called "the modern-day Rasputin."
uncertain: 'Karun Mutiana Island' ([jp]) is a romanization with no English source.

287.en: A 17-year-old boy who was a high school student in TOKYO JUPITER but, after meeting RahXephon, follows a twist of fate. An artistic boy whose hobby is painting, he wants to become a painter in the future. His father is absent and he lives with his mother, Maya Kamina, but they have little interaction, so he does not think much of her. When TOKYO JUPITER was invaded, he met Haruka, learned the truth of the world, and boarded RahXephon in the Room of Rah as it led him. He is easily swept along by his surroundings, but he is the type to come through when it matters. His emotions swing widely, and toward people he dislikes he tends to avoid rather than resist. When he first escaped from TOKYO JUPITER, he felt that values different from his previous ones were being forced on him and felt resistance, but this gradually faded through contact with various people, and he grew as a person. His sense of fashion seems slightly off.
uncertain: The mother is 'Maya Kamina' from the glossary; the Japanese just says [jp].

290.en: The form of Ayato who has reached the true heart "Yolteotl." In this form he has lost his human heart and obtained a god's heart, and he is no longer human. For that reason he does not die even if he is shot. He can change into Shinsei RahXephon at will. Ixtli, in the form of Reika Mishima, appears before Ayato, who moved other people's hearts through his painting, and Ayato once rejected Ixtli. But his feelings for Haruka made Ayato grow enough to accept Ixtli. Incidentally, the reason Ayato's Ixtli had the form of Reika Mishima is that it extracted Haruka's appearance as a teenager, and his romantic feelings for her, from his erased memories. In the world of tuning, Ayato had almost lost the memories of other people. The form in which he has obtained the true face "Ixtli" and the deified heart "Yolteotl" is called "Ixtli in Yolteotl," and it indicates one who has become a complete human.
uncertain: 'Ixtli in Yolteotl' follows the game's [jp] (the game spells the second word differently from [jp]).
'it extracted': subject of the extraction read as Ixtli; 'his romantic feelings for her' = [jp] for Haruka.

291.en: Ayato Kamina's mother and a powerful Mulian. Perhaps because it is just the two of them, she dotes on Ayato, but Ayato does not seem to feel the same way. She holds full authority over the MU Tokyo Government-General, and when the attack on Tokyo began she gave orders from the Tokyo Government-General's central command room. She has supernatural powers such as levitation, and when RahXephon awoke, she cut her cheek on a flying fragment and shed blue blood. She is extremely composed, and even when Ayato escaped from TOKYO JUPITER she saw him off fearlessly.

292.en: Chief of the Analysis Section of the TERRA Science Research Department. 29 years old. In addition to specializing in research on music centered on the D1 aria emitted by Dolems, he is also in charge of analyzing RahXephon and the OOPArts of the Neriya Temple. He was a university classmate of Haruka, and they once went out together. He currently lives in a mansion with his younger sister, Quon Kisaragi, and his favorite drink is tomato juice. He also paints as a hobby. He has strong self-control and always acts cheerful, but seems to hold complex feelings toward Ayato. Like Quon, Itsuki sometimes calls Ayato "Ollin."
uncertain: 'Neriya Temple' is a literal rendering.

293.en: The younger sister of Itsuki Kisaragi of the TERRA Science Research Department. Her age, birthday, affiliation and so on are all unknown, and although she is not a TERRA employee she is allowed in the command center and to take part in operations. She lives with her brother, and her favorite drink is a blue drink. She likes music, and plays the piano and the violin herself. She undergoes examinations almost every day, and always wears a Life Module because it is necessary for sustaining her life. She is a mysterious girl who now and then murmurs poetic words that accurately capture incidents and features that are yet to occur. She is easygoing and keeps her own pace, and somehow has a world of her own. Her catchphrase is "Ra-ra...," which she often hummed in the middle of conversations. She calls Ayato "Ollin" and has a mysterious mark on her abdomen.
uncertain: Catchphrase rendered 'Ra-ra...' ([jp]…); the Wikipedia list gives 'Ra-ra' / 'La-la'.

294.en: The form of Quon who has reached the true heart "Yolteotl." Whereas Ayato found himself through painting, Quon found her own song by playing the piano. In the world of tuning she acted as if guiding Ayato.

295.en: An operator in TERRA's Operations Department. 18 years old, with the rank of second lieutenant. Her emotions run strong, and when the Dolem that killed her parents appeared, she became furiously angry at the insensitive Ayato. She is also a sentimental type who can cry for others. She is secretly going out with Soichi Yakumo without telling anyone around her, and she is troubled when she learns of Megumi's feelings for Soichi. Incidentally, her name is written with the Chinese characters for "gold," "lake" and "moon."
295.notes: The Japanese gives the characters [jp]; rendered by meaning because the kanji cannot be shown in ASCII.
uncertain: Kanji-by-meaning rendering of the name note.

296.en: Commander of the MU Tokyo Government-General Defense Force. Although he was a soldier belonging to the Ministry of National Defense, he defected to the Mu side during the First Mu War and took the post of the person responsible for commanding the defense of the capital. Like the Public Security, he is thought to have been turned into a sub-Mulian. He is servile and timid toward those stronger than himself, and takes an arrogant attitude toward the weak. Because of that, he apparently cannot hold his head up before Maya. He also seems to have a deep-rooted history with Kunugi.
uncertain: 'Ministry of National Defense' ([jp]) is a literal rendering; the Rah wiki says 'Nation Defense'.
'Public Security' = [jp].

297.en: The TERRA Commander. 43 years old. His name is read "Kunugi Jin" (family name first). TERRA is an abbreviation of Tereno (special domain), Empireo (heaven, highest heaven), Rapidmova (rapid), Reakcii (reaction), Armeo (army). He is strict about discipline and has a stern face, but is trusted by his subordinates. With his keen insight, he chose words that carried his real intent and repeatedly provoked Ayato. He is calm and composed and always shows a severe expression as TERRA's commander, but he also has the unexpected side of keeping a blue bird, "Michiru," in his own room. He has lived apart from his wife, Mariko, for a long time, and the cause seems to lie in the First Mu War.
uncertain: The game prints 'Eepireo'; corrected to 'Empireo' following the RahXephon wiki/Wikipedia (Tereno Empireo Rapidmova Reakcii Armeo).
Nothing in the Japanese settles the order of the abbreviation letters beyond what is printed.

298.en: A public security agent of TOKYO JUPITER. The agent tries to abduct Ayato but is resisted by him, and bleeds blue blood from the cheek. After that, the agent is kicked down by Haruka.
298.notes: Gender-neutral on purpose; no source settles the gender.

299.en: An intelligence analysis officer in TERRA's Operations Department. Her rank is special captain. 29 years old. A professional who handles anything without a hitch, from hand-to-hand combat to piloting fighters. Even when those around her are excited, she does her work at her own pace and sees through what she has decided. During Operation Overlord she infiltrated TOKYO JUPITER, rescued Ayato, who was about to be abducted by Public Security, and told him the truth of the world. Her personality is cheerful with a motherly side, but at times she acts like an adolescent girl, such as by giving Ayato hand-knitted gloves. She seems to have known Itsuki Kisaragi from before she joined TERRA. She is Elvy's drinking buddy, and they often went out for yakiniku. She lives in the Rikudo house with her younger sister Megumi and her uncle Shougo, and has unusual eating habits, such as putting sugar on natto and putting mayonnaise on her rice.
uncertain: Uncle named by given name only in the Japanese ([jp]) = Shougo Rikudo from the glossary.
'special captain' = [jp].

300.en: A trainee operator in TERRA's Operations Department. 14 years old. She refuses to go to school and has a complex about her older sister Haruka. She has a faint crush on Soichi Yakumo, and she is best friends with fellow operator Kim, but she does not know that Soichi and Kim are going out. When she was 8, she and Haruka were taken in by their uncle Shougo. She is bright and lively, and has a heart capable of attentive consideration. At Shougo's suggestion, she showed Ayato, who had been decided to lodge at the Rikudo house, around Negoro Island, and they drank ramune together at a candy store. Since they were close in age and had been something like quarreling friends, they quickly warmed to each other.
uncertain: 'Negoro Island' is a literal rendering of [jp]; no source.
The final sentence's subject is Megumi and Ayato (they).

302.en: A scientist who serves as Itsuki Kisaragi's assistant. 28 years old. Because she secretly harbors feelings for Itsuki, she plays the part of Haruka's friend, but inwardly she holds intense rivalry. She is acutely conscious of being looked at by others and does not wear her glasses in front of men, but when the other person's gaze turns away, her true feelings seem to show on her face. Normally she is calm, but she suddenly snaps, so she seems to be the type who cannot control her emotions. She also has a past in which her father and brother died in the Bahbem Foundation's basic research on TDD.
uncertain: 'TDD' kept as printed ([jp]), related to the TDDU system.

303.en: The niece and secretary of Lord Bahbem. 29 years old. She has a way of looking down on others from a transcendent height, as if she had seen through everything. She is an old acquaintance of Itsuki Kisaragi and Makoto Isshiki, but both of them have been uneasy around her, then and now. She is calm and composed and almost never shows her emotions. As an envoy of the Bahbem Foundation, she visited Nirai Kanai together with the delivery of the Vermillion.

304.en: A beautiful girl who guides the awakening of Ayato and RahXephon. She resembles the girl in the painting that Ayato was in the middle of painting. She encountered Ayato in a corner of the ruined TOKYO JUPITER and whispered meaningful words to him. She has special abilities, such as guiding the ALIEL that Haruka was riding to the Room of Rah and activating RahXephon with her song. She was thought to have died when Ayato escaped from Tokyo, but she is a mysterious person who appears before Ayato again and again and acts as if guiding him.

305.en: A reporter from Amato News who came to Nirai Kanai for an exclusive interview. 36 years old. His name is read "Futagami Johji" (family name first). He excels at gathering and organizing information, and is independently investigating the course of the Mu War and the Shrine of Time and so on. He also links the other party's behavioral psychology and relationships to various mysteries, and asks key persons questions that strike at the heart of the matter. He is capable enough to obtain important secrets and classified documents, yet he speaks in a flippant, grinning manner and is a person whose hidden side cannot be seen.
uncertain: 'Mu War' ([jp]) rendered 'the Mu War'; the earlier text says 'First Mu War' for [jp].

306.en: An officer of the MU Tokyo Government-General Defense Force. Like Kuki, she was a soldier belonging to the Ministry of National Defense, but she defected to the Mu side during the First Mu War. Her goal is the completion of a utopia, and she seems to have cooperated with the Mu for that purpose. In battle she judges the situation calmly and objectively, and is entrusted with Dolem operations. She, too, is thought to have been turned into a sub-Mulian.

307.name_jp: ムーリアン・アレグレット
307.en: The operator of the Dolem Allegretto. When a Dolem sorties, the Mulian appears in places such as the MU Tokyo Government-General's central command room. A Mulian is paired with its Dolem, and when the Dolem is destroyed, the Mulian disappears as well. The body is transparent, and it is unknown whether it has substance.
uncertain: Gender not settled; 'the Mulian ... its Dolem' used, 'it' only for the body.

308.name_jp: ムーリアン・ヴィブラート
308.en: A Mulian that possessed Hiroko Asahina. Unlike other Mulians, because it has taken hold of a human, it has substance. Because it is synchronized with Hiroko, when the Dolem Vibrato is wounded, Hiroko is hurt too. It kept frightening Hiroko, for example by appearing in the dreams of Hiroko, who was living as a fugitive with Ayato. When the Dolem Vibrato appeared and Ayato boarded RahXephon, it fully synchronized with Hiroko, but it was not able to completely take over Hiroko's will.

309.name_jp: ムーリアン・グラーベ
309.en: The operator of the Dolem Grave.

310.name_jp: ムーリアン・ビバーチェ
310.en: The operator of the Dolem Vivace. This Mulian swallowed RahXephon into phase space and made Ayato see an illusion that he was in TOKYO JUPITER.

311.name_jp: ムーリアン・メトロノーム
311.en: The operator of the Dolem Metronome.

312.en: The TERRA Deputy Commander. 22 years old, with the rank of major. His name is read "Yakumo Souichi" (family name first). He and Kunugi place absolute trust in each other, and he often takes command in the field in place of Kunugi, who is frequently away. He is affable and attentive even to small details, so he is a prince-like figure who is very popular with both men and women. Although he never loses his smile, he handles things carefully so as not to get too deeply involved, so he sometimes gives a cold impression, but he seems to hold a fervent conviction in the depths of his heart. Incidentally, feeding the blue bird that Kunugi keeps is mostly Soichi's job. He is going out with Kim, but keeps it secret from those around him.

313.en: The uncle of Haruka and Megumi. 62 years old. A former archaeologist. His name is read "Rikudou Shougo" (family name first). A person of character who shows propriety and common sense with few words. He is something like a foster father to Megumi, and taught her "Do not do to others what you would not want done to you." For Ayato, who lodged at the Rikudo house, he made a nameplate, and with his attitude of acting without words he opened Ayato's heart. He is an old acquaintance of Watari and Kunugi and a good advisor to them as well. He should be a shogi master, but he apparently lost to Quon now and then.

314.en: The Director of TERRA. 60 years old. His name is read "Watari Shirou" (family name first). Because he flies around the world to coordinate and negotiate with the parties concerned, he is often absent from TERRA headquarters and leaves the running of the organization to Kunugi. His hobby is buying souvenirs at his business trip destinations. For some reason he puts on a solemn expression when he is with Itsuki Kisaragi. Although he has a rugged appearance, he has a humorous side, and on seeing RahXephon and Alpha Squadron he muttered, "Cool..."
uncertain: '[jp]' rendered 'Cool...'.

315.en: An operator who teams up with #男愛称 and boards the Tsentr Project prototypes. She has a spirited and cheerful personality. Unlike #男愛称, she grew up in a wealthy family and graduated from the military academy with excellent grades. Incidentally, the outfit that looks like a swimsuit is called a DFC (Direct Feeling Control) suit, and it is necessary for adjusting the TE Engine's output, assisting machine control, collecting combat data and so on. Age 23, rank ensign.
315.notes: The Japanese contains the text placeholder #男愛称 (the male protagonist's nickname variable). Kept verbatim because it is a runtime placeholder; count its expanded width, not its 4 characters.
uncertain: Placeholder #男愛称 kept in the English text (non-ASCII by necessity).
Rank [jp] rendered 'ensign' per the SRW wiki.

316.en: A former Federation soldier. He once served as the commander of the special unit "Cry Wolves," to which #男愛称 used to belong. A bold character and an excellent humanoid mobile weapon pilot. He was a teacher to #男愛称 and a father-like figure as well. He left the army because of a certain incident and went missing, but he seized the Medius Locus together with Eldy Middi. Age 46.
316.notes: The Japanese contains the text placeholder #男愛称 (the male protagonist's nickname variable). Kept verbatim; count its expanded width.
uncertain: Placeholder #男愛称 kept in the English text.
Name spelling 'Albero Esto' follows the SRW wiki; other sources say 'Albero Est'.

317.en: A researcher of combat artificial intelligence who rides the Medius Locus as its operator. She acts on the instructions of Dr. Mitar Zapat, but her true purpose is unknown. She developed the special combat AI "AI1 (A-I-One)" for the Medius Locus and dotes on it like her own child. Age 30.
uncertain: Name spelling 'Eldy Middi' follows the SRW wiki; other sources say 'Elde Mitte'.
'Dr. Mitar Zapat' (SRW wiki page title; other spelling Mitall Zapato).

322.en: From the Federation Army's special unit "Cry Wolves." He currently participates in the "Tsentr Project" being pursued within the Federation Army, and serves as the test pilot of the prototypes, teamed up with #女愛称. Because he has faced poverty since he was a child, he has a strong attachment to life. His emotions swing widely, but he is usually somewhat short on words. Age 20, rank ensign.
322.notes: The Japanese contains the text placeholder #女愛称 (the female protagonist's nickname variable). Kept verbatim; count its expanded width.
uncertain: Placeholder #女愛称 kept in the English text.

323.en: The person in charge of the Tsentr Project. He is also the developer of the TE Engine and Lasmunanium. While knowing that he is using the military for his own research and that the military is also using him, he is advancing his own project beneath the surface. Age 56.
uncertain: 'Mitar Zapat' follows the SRW wiki page title; alternatives Mitall Zapato (LP), Mitarl Zapad (wiki list).

337.en: A member of the Argama's bridge crew. He is in charge of navigation and steering. A quiet, inconspicuous type.

339.en: Shinji's classmate. He, Shinji and Toji are called the "Three Idiots Trio" by their classmates. He has been Toji's best friend since before Shinji transferred in. A military maniac, he showed an interest in the Eva too, and finally begged Misato to let him ride an Eva. He always carries a video camera, and happily films whenever he finds anything weapon-related.
uncertain: 'Three Idiots Trio' is a literal rendering of [jp].

342.en: A public security agent of TOKYO JUPITER. The agent points a gun at Ayato's head to abduct him, but is knocked unconscious by a knee to the face from Haruka, who appears suddenly. The agent was beside Maya in the Room of Rah, and was swallowed by rubble when Allegretto appeared.
342.notes: Gender-neutral on purpose; no source settles the gender.

388.en: The form in which the core housing AI1 has grown huge and fused with the TE Engine through the runaway self-repair and self-evolution abilities of the Lasmunanium. True to its name, "ALL In 1," it tries to take everything into its own body.
388.notes: fix_C.txt lists no owner record for this pilot entry; the text clearly describes the AI1 boss form, so it is kept under AI1.
uncertain: No owner record in the corrections file; name kept as AI1 because the text is about the AI1 core.
Name printed 'ALL In 1' in the game (glossary: All In 1).

389.notes: fix_C.txt lists no owner record for this pilot entry; the Japanese text is [jp] ('none'), so it is a placeholder.
uncertain: No owner record; placeholder entry.

183.en: A Gundam Fighter representing Neo Russia. Age 26. He was once the leader of a space pirate group famous as colony raiders, but he and his men were captured, and he entered the Gundam Fight in exchange for his comrades' lives. Except during fights, his arms were bound together with a beam chain, and a small bomb to make him obey was planted in the belt on his chest. He is a taciturn man who never loses his self-control, but he hides a burning passion within. He excels at power techniques delivered from a huge frame of over two meters, and he inherits the crest of the Black Joker and becomes a member of the new Shuffle Alliance.
uncertain: Shuffle Alliance: SRW T localization renders it 'Shuffle Union'; 'Shuffle Alliance' (anime/Gundam Wiki) used.

184.name_jp: アレンビー・ビアズリー
184.en: A Gundam Fighter representing Neo Sweden. Age 17. She is a second lieutenant in her country's space forces. She lost her parents in early childhood and was given an elite education in a military facility to become a Gundam Fighter, but only after meeting Domon and the others did she feel peace of mind for the first time. A bright and energetic girl, she has feelings for Domon, but in the end she stepped aside, considering his relationship with Rain. She has genius combat sense and uses techniques that build rhythmic gymnastics movements onto a base of martial arts.
uncertain: 'second lieutenant' for shoui (rank).

185.en: A soldier of the Neo Japan colony. His rank is major. He holds the belief that power is justice and is also a central figure in the Gundam Development Bureau. He was once a Gundam Fighter, and has the experience of entering the 12th tournament and losing to Master Asia. He is the mastermind of the Devil Gundam incident and tried to seize hegemony using its power, but was defeated by Domon and the new Shuffle Alliance.
uncertain: '12th tournament' = the 12th Gundam Fight.
'Gundam Development Bureau' (Gundam Kaihatsu-kyoku) is a literal rendering.

186.en: The Prime Minister of Neo Hong Kong, which became the host nation of the 13th Gundam Fight because Master Asia won the previous tournament. He is ambitious, and the type to scheme without dirtying his own hands. As chairman of the tournament committee he rigged matches and plotted permanent rule over the colony nations using the power of the Devil Gundam, but in the end, infected by DG Cells, he boarded the Walter Gundam and was defeated by Domon. He liked sweet things and always had snacks in his mouth.
uncertain: Source omits 'o' (boarded the Walter Gundam); read as 'boarded'.

187.en: His full name is Raizo Kasshu. A scientist of Neo Japan, Domon's father, and the developer of the Ultimate Gundam. The Ultimate Gundam used Ultimate Cell that perform "self-regeneration," "self-evolution" and "self-replication," and it was being developed as the ultimate Mobile Fighter with the aim of purifying the Earth's environment. But because of Urube's scheme he was made to take responsibility for the incident of Kyoji's theft of the Ultimate Gundam, and was sentenced to cryogenic imprisonment. He was later rescued by Rain and cooperates with Domon to defeat the Devil Gundam.
uncertain: 'Kyoji' is not identified in the text (Kyoji Kasshu, Domon's brother, per Gundam Wiki).
'Ultimate Cells' is a literal rendering (the Gundam Wiki calls the same technology DG Cells).

188.en: A Gundam Fighter representing Neo Nepal. An assassin feared as the Grim Reaper Kyral, who killed opponents before their matches in order to win by default. He has superb perception that more than makes up for the handicap of being blind, and excels at the Kyral technique using a sword cane. After fighting and losing to Domon, he set out on a pilgrimage to pray for the souls of the people he had killed until then, but he came rushing to the final battle with the Devil Gundam leading the Gundam Coalition.
uncertain: 'Gundam Coalition' (Gundam Rengou) is a literal rendering; the Gundam Wiki uses 'Coalition of Volunteers' / 'World Gundam Federation' for related factions.
'Kyral technique' = Kyral Satsuho (Kyral-style killing technique) shortened as in the source.

189.en: Sai Saici's minder and foster parent. His name is read "Keiun." A master of Shaolin kung fu, he took part in the tournament as Sai Saici's support crew. He always acts as a set with Zuisen, but he is more the physical-strength one.
uncertain: 'Shaolin kung fu' for Shorinji kenpo; Gundam Wiki calls them Shaolin monks.
Gender: male per Gundam Wiki (Zuizen and Keiun page).

190.en: A Gundam Fighter representing Neo China. He is short and often mistaken for a child, but is actually 16. He comes from a line of martial artists, his grandfather Sai Feilong being the winner of the 4th tournament, but he lost his father at a young age and entered the Gundam Fight aiming to rebuild the Shaolin Temple, his father's cherished wish. He is the successor of Shaolin, and his skill at kung fu is genius-level. He is somewhat of a showoff, and looked up to Domon as his big brother, but he inherits the title of Club Ace and becomes a member of the new Shuffle Alliance. He is good at cooking, and his fried rice is especially superb.
uncertain: '4th tournament' = the 4th Gundam Fight.

191.name_jp: ジェントル・チャップマン
191.en: A Gundam Fighter representing Neo England who won three times in a row in the past, and pilot of the John Bull Gundam. A gentleman who was called a hero in his home country. He is a master rifle shot, and his three consecutive victories caused a stir in the melee-centered Gundam Fight. He entered the 13th tournament in spite of illness, but was infected by DG Cells and became one of the Devil Gundam's Four Heavenly Kings.
uncertain: Gundam Wiki also writes 'Neo Britain' in the infobox; 'Neo England' used (body text, game).

192.name_jp: ジョルジュ・ド・サンド
192.en: A Gundam Fighter representing Neo France. Age 20. The young head of the de Sand family, which values the spirit of chivalry; he entered the tournament together with his butler Raymond for the great cause of protecting the people. He excels at fencing, and the sharpness of his technique is first-rate. He likes fair and square fights and dislikes despicable behavior; he is serious by nature and swore loyalty to his homeland and Princess Maria Louise. He inherited the title of Jack in Diamond and becomes a member of the new Shuffle Alliance. His hobbies are tea and rose growing, and he often acted foppishly, such as scattering roses at the unveiling of a new special move.
uncertain: 'Maria Louise' per Gundam Wiki; the game katakana could also be 'Marie Louise'.
Pun in the source (bara wo barama ku = scattering roses) cannot be kept; rendered literally.

193.en: Sai Saici's minder and foster parent. His name is read "Zuisen." A master of Shaolin kung fu, he took part in the tournament as Sai Saici's support crew. He always acts as a set with Keiun, but he is more the brains one.
uncertain: Source reading is 'Zuisen'; the Gundam Wiki romanizes the name as 'Zuizen' (used).
Gender: male per Gundam Wiki.

195.name_jp: チボデー・クロケット
195.en: A Gundam Fighter representing Neo America. Age 20. He was a delinquent from downtown New York, but he embodies the American Dream by winning 100 straight matches in colony boxing. Leading the Chibodee Gals, who are also former delinquents, he entered the tournament to grasp the American Dream again. He has the personality of a true cheerful American, with strong patriotism and sense of justice as well. He inherits the crest of the Queen the Spade and becomes a member of the new Shuffle Alliance. Because of a memory of being caught up in a riot at a circus tent in childhood, he is bad with clowns.
uncertain: 'Queen the Spade' follows the Gundam Wiki spelling.

198.en: A Gundam Fighter representing Neo Japan, the champion of colony martial arts and holder of the title King of Hearts. Age 20. In order to clear his father's disgrace, he entered the tournament chasing the Devil Gundam, which had fled to Earth. King of Hearts is outwardly the title of the Colony Martial Arts King, but in truth it is the proof of the leader of the Shuffle Alliance. The Shuffle Alliance is a group that has controlled conflicts from the shadows of history and prevented the extinction of humanity, and the previous King of Hearts was Master Asia, who was also Domon's master. Domon studied under Master Asia from the age of ten and mastered the School of the Undefeated of the East, and his fighting sense is such that he catches bullets with his bare hands. He also attained the state of Meikyoshisui through training during the tournament and became the winner of the 13th Gundam Fight. By nature he is a headstrong fighting fool, and at first he gave off an unfriendly, standoffish air, but through meeting comrades and talking with fists, he awakened to friendship and love, and in the end grew to the point of, clumsily, confessing his love to Rain.
uncertain: 'School of the Undefeated of the East' (ryuuha Touhou Fuhai) - rendered as a school name; wiki calls Master Asia 'Undefeated of the East'.
'Meikyoshisui' kept in romanized form (clear mind, still water).

199.en: Master Asia's beloved horse. Because it wears a fighter suit itself and operates the Mobile Horse, there is a rumor that it has mastered the School of the Undefeated of the East. After Master Asia's death, it accepts Domon as its rider and acts together with him.
uncertain: Gender of the horse not established by a source; 'it' used.

200.name_jp: ミケロ・チャリオット
200.en: A Gundam Fighter representing Neo Italy and pilot of the Neros Gundam. A boss of the Italian mafia, he entered the tournament to show off his own strength. Cruel by nature, he had a special move called Silver Legs, but lost to Domon in the very first episode. After that he was infected by DG Cells and revived, and took on the role of one of the Devil Gundam's Four Heavenly Kings; a rare person whose personality did not change before and after being infected by DG Cells.
uncertain: Source says 'first episode' (dai-1-wa); kept as 'the very first episode'.

201.en: Domon's partner and childhood friend. Age 20. She is the daughter of Dr. Mikamura and an excellent doctor. She is also well versed in mechanics and supports everything from maintaining the Gundam to looking after Domon. She is not only caring but also energetic, and sometimes fought riding a Gundam. She secretly holds romantic feelings for Domon, but she could not easily say so because of the insensitive Domon and her own heart that cannot be honest. She was used as the core of the Devil Gundam's final form but was rescued by Domon, and delivered the finishing blow to the Devil Gundam with the "Sekiha Love Love Tenkyoken."
uncertain: Source says she 'delivered the finishing blow' with the move; the actual attack is a joint move with Domon (in the show), kept as written.

202.en: The pilot of Mazinger Z. He is the grandson of Mazinger Z's developer Juzo Kabuto, and the son of Great Mazinger's developer Kenzo Kabuto. He carried on the will of his grandfather, who was killed by Baron Ashura, and fought Dr. Hell, who plotted world conquest. After his grandfather's death, he moved to the Photon Power Laboratory with his younger brother Shiro and transferred into the first year of the high school division of Tojo Academy. He is an action-oriented hothead who also tends to get carried away, and was often seen rushing ahead and falling into enemy traps. He is also a soft-hearted man of justice and is trusted by those around him. He boasts outstanding athletic ability, and his skill at his hobby, motorcycles, is first-rate. After defeating Dr. Hell, he went to study at NASA with Sayaka, but returned to Japan for the decisive battle with the Mycenae Empire, and boarded Mazinger Z again and fought alongside Great Mazinger. Afterward, he also admirably protected the Earth as a member of the Grendizer Team against the Vegan Empire's invasion. Note that when he appeared in Grendizer, his combat suit had been redesigned.
uncertain: 'Tojo Academy' (Toujou Gakuen) is a literal romanization; Mazinger wiki spelling not verified.
'Vegan Empire' used for the Vega Star League (wiki name).

203.en: Boss's henchman. As his nickname says, he is a laid-back type. He is relatively sensible, and sometimes spoke against Boss's reckless actions and got scolded for it. He has always been with Boss and Mucha since their Minato Nursery School days, and when they were little he sometimes bullied the crybaby Boss. Surprisingly, he is good at sports and a good skier.
uncertain: 'Minato Nursery School' (Minato Hoikuen) is a literal romanization.

204.en: Koji's classmate. Partly because he has a crush on Sayaka, he treats Koji as a rival at every turn. To compete with Mazinger Z, he had the three scientists of the Photon Power Laboratory build him his own personal robot, Boss Borot, and joined the fighting together with his henchmen Nuke and Mucha, but was often more of a hindrance. However, he is a warm-hearted man of justice and an irreplaceable best friend to Koji. After Dr. Hell fell and the Mycenae Empire began its invasion of the surface, he cooperated with the Science Fortress Laboratory and fought alongside Great Mazinger. When Koji fought the Vegan Empire as part of the Grendizer Team, he also showed up as a helper. Like Nuke and Mucha, his real name is unknown.

205.en: Boss's henchman. As his nickname says, he has a reckless personality and rides his motorcycle roughly. He is small but spirited, and sometimes piloted Boss Borot in Boss's place. His grades at school are not good, but he has a streak of cunning and did things like stealing fuel from the Jet Pilder.

206.en: His real name is Gennosuke Yumi. He is the top disciple of Juzo Kabuto and serves as the director of the Photon Power Laboratory. He is also the developer of Aphrodite A and Diana A, which his daughter Sayaka pilots, and he made numerous modifications to Mazinger Z during the fight against Dr. Hell. He is gentle and calm by nature, and has the sense of responsibility and judgment befitting the director of the Photon Power Laboratory fighting Dr. Hell. After defeating Dr. Hell, he left the fight with the Mycenae Empire to the Science Fortress Laboratory and returned to his original duty of researching Photon Power energy.
uncertain: 'Gennosuke' per Wikipedia / Mazinger Wiki.

207.en: The daughter of Professor Yumi and the pilot of Diana A. She does not attend high school and helps with her father's research at the Photon Power Laboratory. She is strong-willed, and although she and Koji are like fighting friends, inwardly she worries about him more than anyone. For that very reason, she grew jealous of Koji, who is weak to beautiful women, and the team sometimes failed to coordinate in battle and got into trouble. After defeating Dr. Hell, she studied at NASA with Koji, but returned to Japan for the decisive battle with the Mycenae Empire and threw herself into the fighting again.
uncertain: 'the team sometimes failed to coordinate' - the source subject is dropped; read as Sayaka and Koji failing to coordinate.

208.en: The developer of Great Mazinger and the biological father of Koji Kabuto and Shiro. He was developing Mazinger Z together with Koji's grandfather Juzo Kabuto, but was seriously injured in an accident at that time and was given cyborg surgery by Juzo. Afterward he developed Great Mazinger and, as director of the Science Fortress Laboratory, stood against the Mycenae Empire's invasion of the surface. He raised the orphans Tetsuya and Jun and holds family affection for them, but out of a sense of responsibility and duty to protect peace, he cannot show those feelings openly and sometimes stays ruthless. He also has a complex about being a cyborg and feels guilty toward Koji and the others, to whom he cannot act like a father. In the final battle with the Mycenae Empire, he threw himself out to save Tetsuya, who, because of his complex as an orphan, had refused to coordinate with Koji and fallen into a pinch, and did not return. In the movie "Mazinger Z vs. the Great General of Darkness," he appears from the opening dressed as a prophet (?) and prophesies the revival of the Mycenae Empire and that Boss Borot will fly through the sky.
uncertain: 'Koji and the others' kept as in the source (Koji-tachi); likely Koji and Shiro.
Movie title: Mazinger wiki uses 'Mazinger Z vs. Great General of Darkness'; article 'the' added here.
'(?)' is in the source (cosplay (?)).

209.en: The pilot of Great Mazinger. In order to pilot Great Mazinger, which was developed as a combat robot, he was taken in from an orphanage by Kenzo Kabuto at the age of seven and put through harsh training. Because he was raised as a combat professional, he has high combat ability even bare-handed. His upbringing and nihilistic way of talking give him an unapproachable, cold impression, but in reality he is kind-hearted and a strict man of justice. He inwardly admires Kenzo Kabuto, who took him in and raised him, like a father, yet has a strong complex about being an orphan. For that reason he was jealous at the sight of Koji and Kenzo, who returned home for the decisive battle with the Mycenae Empire, and made an irreparable mistake in the final battle. Note that at the time "Great Mazinger" started airing, the setting was age 22, but this was later changed to 18, making him more youthful. Incidentally, in the comic version by Gosaku Ota, he has a more comical side than in the TV version while being an even harder character.
uncertain: 'the sight of Koji and Kenzo, who returned home' - the relative clause 'returned home' could attach to Koji only; kept as written in the source ('Koji and Kenzo who returned').
'Gosaku Ota' per Mazinger wiki.

210.en: The pilot of Venus A. Like Tetsuya, she was taken in from an orphanage as a combat professional and put through harsh training. She is usually spirited and competitive, but inwardly she has a complex about her birth and sometimes worries alone.

220.en: One of the Hyakki Empire's executives on par with Hidler, and a scientist-engineer. Besides developing and researching robots and weapons, he devises invasion plans, handling the whole of the Hyakki Empire's intellectual side. Many talented young elites seem to gather under him. He is cool-headed, but sometimes behaves strangely. He left the gravity control device to Burai and died in an explosion together with the Combined Hyakki Robot.
uncertain: 'Hidler' (Hydler / Hidler variants).

221.en: The pilot of the Poseidon Machine and Getter Poseidon. A transfer student to Asama Academy, he became acquainted with Genki, the son of Dr. Saotome, and was scouted as the Poseidon Machine's pilot for his extraordinary stamina and brute strength. Although he declined at first, he regretted that Genki was injured in an attack by the Hyakki Empire and joined the fighting in the Poseidon Machine of his own accord. By nature he is an easygoing man who dislikes fighting, and he has the gentleness to love animals and children. His hobby is baseball, and he later became captain of Asama Academy's baseball team. Note that in the original work he never uses Musashi's special move, Daisetsuzan Oroshi.
uncertain: Source says 'Poseidon-gou' (Poseidon Machine); rendered 'Poseidon Machine'.

225.en: The pilot of the Liger Machine and Getter Liger. At the time of the Dinosaur Empire's invasion of the surface, he turned down his classmate Ryoma's request to board the Getter once, but when Michiru, who bears the likeness of his late mother, was in danger, he volunteered to be a pilot himself. He is a cool nihilist with outstanding athletic ability and is also thoughtful, so he is easily misunderstood by others, and he clashed several times with the direct Ryoma and Musashi. Yet he is a quietly hot-blooded man burning with a sense of mission, and deep in his heart he is bound to his comrades by deep ties. His hobby is the harmonica.
uncertain: 'Michiru, who bears the likeness of his late mother' - the source phrase (omokage) read as a resemblance.

226.en: The daughter of Dr. Saotome and a student at Asama Academy like Ryoma and the others. She helps with her father's research and supports the Getter Team by handling reconnaissance, searching and supply with the Command Machine, Lady Command. She is the Getter Team's madonna, has both a spirited side and womanly gentleness, but several times showed jealousy at the appearance of beautiful guest characters. In the final battle with the Hyakki Empire, she pilots the Liger Machine in place of the absent Hayato. Also, it seems she accepted Hayato's feelings just before that final battle.
uncertain: Subject of the last sentence: Michiru accepted Hayato's feelings (restored).

227.en: The director of the Saotome Institute. He lost his eldest son Tatsuhito in the Dinosaur Empire's first invasion, leaving a family of four: his wife Kazuko, eldest daughter Michiru and second son Genki. A leading authority on Getter Ray research, he originally built Getter Robo for space development, but for the war with the Dinosaur Empire he sent out an armed Getter and later completed the new-type Getter Robo for combat. Although he looks shabby with his unkempt beard and geta sandals, he is not only a first-rate researcher but also commands the Getter Team in battle with calm judgment and accurate instructions. His personality is usually gentle, but he also has a side that stops the three hotheads even by shouting at them.
uncertain: 'the three hotheads' = the three pilots (Ryoma, Hayato, Benkei or Musashi, depending on the series); left generic.
'Tatsuhito', 'Kazuko', 'Genki' per Getter Robo wiki.

228.en: The ruler of the Hyakki Empire. He had been hiding in the deep sea for a long time, but after watching the Dinosaur Empire fall and seeing Getter Robo take heavy damage, he raised the Science Fortress Island and set out to conquer the world. In order to replenish energy and to build powerful Hyakki Robots, he targeted the Getter Ray amplifier and attacked the Saotome Institute. He is cold-hearted and ruthless, choosing any means for his ambitions, and even ordered the elimination of Risa, his own real daughter who betrayed the empire. Note that the horns of the Hyakki clan are attached by modification surgery, and they die if their horns are destroyed.
uncertain: 'Risa' (Lisa/Risa) - spelling not verified in an English source.
'Science Fortress Island' (kagaku yosai-tou) is a literal rendering.

229.en: One of the Hyakki Empire's executives and its combat commander. He swore loyalty to Burai and drew up a variety of operations. He goes to the battlefield and gives orders to the combat units, and sometimes personally leads bombers into battle. He is cruel and base by nature, and chooses any means to defeat Getter Robo, such as interfering with Tekkouki, who wants a one-on-one duel with Getter Robo.
uncertain: 'Tekkouki' is a Hyakki Robot / oni named in the source (Getter wiki lists 'Mecha Tekkouki').

230.en: The pilot of the Dragon Machine and Getter Dragon. The captain of Asama Academy's soccer club, he fights as a Getter Robo pilot in place of Tatsuhito, the son of Dr. Saotome, who lost his life in the Dinosaur Empire's invasion of the surface. He has a strong sense of responsibility and a serious, single-minded personality; although he is somewhat inflexible at times, he held the Getter Team together as its leader. His family home in Kyushu is a kendo dojo, he himself has some skill with the sword, and he sometimes fought putting it to use. His prized vehicle is a sidecar, in which he often had Musashi ride beside him.
uncertain: Source says 'Dragon-gou' (Dragon Machine).

231.en: A young man who works at Shirakaba Ranch while helping with the research of his foster father, Genzo Umon. Daisuke Umon is a temporary guise; his true self is Duke Fleed, the pilot of Grendizer. For that reason, when the fight against the Vegan Empire begins, he transforms into his combat suit with the shout "Duke Fleed." Concealing his identity is considered synonymous with protecting the Earth, and few people know his true identity. Normally he is good at guitar and horse riding, a serious young man who loves beautiful nature, and is adored by those around him for his kind heart that cares for others.
uncertain: 'Shirakaba Ranch' (Birch Ranch) is the game's name; the Mazinger wiki calls it 'Makiba Ranch'.

232.en: The director of the Institute of Space Science and the foster father of Daisuke Umon. His full name is Genzo Umon. A renowned scientist with deep knowledge of UFOs and space science, he co-manages Shirakaba Ranch with Danbei Makiba. He took in Duke, who reached Earth, as an adopted son, and watches over him with affection no different from a real son's. Calm and composed, in battle he becomes a commander and gives accurate instructions.

233.en: The science minister whom King Vega dispatched to Skull Moon Base. He has been ordered by King Vega to cooperate with Commander Gandal, but since they are equal in rank, he sometimes takes independent action. Brilliant, he designed and developed a variety of destructive weapons and Saucer Beasts. He also surpasses Lady Gandal in strategy and scheming, and troubled Grendizer with vicious plans. Under the eyepatch over his left eye is a small computer and projector, which are used for information and battlefield analysis. Incidentally, his son's name is Zuril Jr.
uncertain: 'Science Minister' (kagaku choukan) follows the Mazinger wiki title; 'Commander Gandal' (wiki: General Gandal).
'Zuril Jr.' per Mazinger wiki (Zuril Jr.).

234.en: The highest authority at the forward base on the Moon, Skull Moon. He gives orders to the operations units at Skull Moon Base and, after Blacky's death, also served as attack captain. His loyalty to King Vega is deep, to the point that he does not hesitate to hurt himself. He also devises cold-blooded plans and thinks nothing of other people's lives to accomplish a mission. Inside him is a separate female personality called Lady Gandal, and the two hold independent views of their own. Gandal prefers to suppress enemies with overwhelming military force, while Lady Gandal excels at bold tactics and psychological warfare using strategy, and the difference of opinion sometimes caused quarrels. In the early period, Gandal's face split open and a small full-body Lady Gandal emerged from inside, but after he suffered serious injuries and underwent plastic surgery, the way she appears changed so that the faces swap by sliding.
uncertain: Pronoun 'he' for Gandal, 'she' for Lady Gandal (Mazinger wiki: Gandal male, Lady Gandal female).
'Blaki' (Blacky in the game's katakana) per Mazinger wiki.

235.en: The dictator who rules Planet Vega. He leads the Vegan Empire and plots to rule the entire universe. Because Planet Vega is on the verge of collapse due to Vegatron radiation, he is after Earth, which has beautiful nature and resembles Planet Vega. After Planet Vega exploded, he went to Skull Moon Base aboard the King of Vega and took command directly. He is a symbol of terror who repeats destruction and plunder with cold cruelty, but he seems to have a soft side toward his daughter Rubina. He was reduced to cosmic dust by the concentrated attack of the Grendizer Team.
uncertain: 'Great King Vega' (Daiou Vega) shortened to 'King Vega' in the body text, as in the Mazinger wiki.

236.name_jp: グレース・マリア・フリード
236.en: Duke Fleed's younger sister, age 14. A tomboy who hates being treated with restraint. She has high physical ability no less than her brother's, and her motorcycle riding skill is considerable. She also has mild precognition and once saved Koji's life from an assassin. During the Vegan Empire's attack on Planet Fleed she was separated from her brother and fled to Earth with an old man who seems to have been an attendant; perhaps she sealed away the painful memory herself, as she seems to have believed she was an Earthling. On Earth she was raised as the old man's granddaughter, but the old man, who happened to witness Grendizer fighting, told her all the secrets, and she came to realize her true identity. At first she mistook Daisuke for an enemy and attacked him, but seeing the royal family's pendant she realized he was her brother, they reconciled, and she became the pilot of the Drill Spazer. While being active as a member of the Dizer Team, she came to feel a faint romantic feeling, drawn by Koji's personality.
uncertain: Full name order: Grace Maria in the game; Wikipedia / Mazinger wiki use 'Maria Grace Fleed' (used in the glossary).
'old man' / 'attendant' (jijuu) kept as in the source; 'Dizer Team' = Grendizer Team (shortened in the source).

238.en: A soldier belonging to King Vega's direct Royal Guard. A whip user with enough skill to accurately pull a glass at a distance to himself. He has calm observation and judgment and excels at tactics that relentlessly attack the opponent's weakness. He attacked and cornered Grendizer during the defenseless "death time" of six seconds from when Grendizer combines with the Spazer until the seat move is complete, and seven and a half seconds from the start of the seat move until separation is complete, but was defeated by Grendizer on its first combination with the Double Spazer.
uncertain: 'Royal Guard' (shineitai) is a literal rendering; the Mazinger wiki calls him 'Commander Jigra'.

239.en: The newly appointed captain of King Vega's direct Royal Guard. A prince of Planet Mole and once Duke Fleed's one-and-only best friend, but he was captured by the Vegan Empire and subjected to mind control, and hated Duke Fleed as the enemy of Planet Mole. During the Vegan Empire's attack on Planet Fleed, he caused Duke Fleed, who tried to help him, to suffer a Vegatron radiation wound. When he faced Duke Fleed in person, the bomb planted in his badge exploded, and the shock brought him back to his senses. After treating Duke Fleed's old Vegatron radiation wound with the Vegatron Minus Beam, he headed to the Moon to attack Skull Moon Base, but lost his life to the self-destruct device that had been set on Jigajiga.
uncertain: Name spelling: 'Mors' from the Mazinger wiki episode title ('Tragedy of Elite Bodyguard Mors'); the Vegan Commanders list shows 'Morros'; katakana Morusu.
'Planet Mole' (Mooru-sei) is a literal romanization.
Gender: the text calls him a prince (oji); no other source.

243.name_jp: 地球攻撃隊長ブラッキー
243.en: The attack captain of the Vegan Empire's Earth invasion operation. Acting on Commander Gandal's orders, he descended to Earth in the Motherburn and took personal command of the effort to defeat Grendizer and subdue the planet. He is a model soldier, burning with a sense of mission and always fighting with resolve to die, but he also has a cowardly side that does not shrink from betrayal to protect his own position. His plans were sloppy at the finish and he failed time and again, and in the end he made a suicide attack on Grendizer and was killed in action.
uncertain: Spelling 'Blaki' (Mazinger wiki / Wikipedia) vs the game's katakana Burakkii (Blacky).

244.en: The prince of Planet Fleed, which was destroyed by the Vegan Empire, and the pilot of Grendizer. He has high physical ability and telepathy. When Planet Fleed was attacked, he was exposed to Vegatron radiation in his right arm as the price of saving a close friend. At that time he was also captured by the Vegan Empire and confined, but he seized Grendizer, escaped, and challenged them all alone. But Planet Fleed was destroyed, and afterward he drifted through space and reached Earth, where he lived peacefully as Daisuke Umon. When he learned that the Vegan Empire's hand had reached Earth, at first, because of memories of past battles, he refused to board Grendizer, but he swore to fight to protect Earth, his second home. Sincere and deeply fond of Earth, he is normally mild, but he shows anger toward the Vegan Empire and attacks without mercy.
uncertain: 'close friend' (shin'yuu) - the text does not name him here; entry 239 suggests Mors.

245.en: Low-ranking soldiers of the Vegan Empire. They are armed with laser guns and always move in twos or threes. They perform various duties such as guarding bases, carrying cargo, and piloting Minifos.
uncertain: Plural used because the source describes them as a group; gender not established.

248.en: The head of Shirakaba Ranch and the father of Hikaru and Goro. As the president of the "Society for Befriending Space Aliens," he often skipped work to go skywatching, which troubled Hikaru. He is good with a lasso, and when he worked as a cowboy in Texas long ago he seems to have been called "Dan the Quick Draw." He also loves Hikaru too much, and tries to hang any man who approaches Hikaru. Of a bottomlessly cheerful nature, he normally gives the impression of being too precarious to leave alone, but he has also shown a side of a fine father who tightens up when he should. He mistook Koji, who came out of the TFO, for an alien.
uncertain: Club name "Uchuujin to nakayoku naru kai" has no established English; 'Society for Befriending Space Aliens' is a translation.
Nickname: Mazinger wiki says 'Dan of the Hail' (differs from 'Quick Draw'); 'Quick Draw' follows the Japanese (nukiuchi).
'Goro' (Goro Makiba) per Mazinger wiki.

249.en: The eldest daughter of the Makiba family, who works at Shirakaba Ranch. As she worked with Daisuke at the ranch, she came to have feelings for him. When she learned that Daisuke was Duke Fleed, she worried over whether there was anything she could do, decided in the end to fight together with him, and later became the pilot of the Marine Spazer. Blessed with outstanding athletic ability, a high level of riding skill and a light touch of movement, she succeeded in the Combination Cross, which had given Koji trouble, in two attempts during actual combat without special training. Although somewhat of a tomboy when with her younger brother Goro, her cheerfulness plus her gentle nature and strong will became a support for Duke Fleed.
uncertain: 'Marine Spazer' per Mazinger wiki.

250.en: The daughter of King Vega and Duke Fleed's former fiancee. She was once sent to Planet Fleed through political maneuvering, and fell in love with Duke at that time. She was told that Duke Fleed was alive on Planet Ruby, which the Vegan Empire governs, and reunited with him on Earth. And she told him that Planet Fleed was recovering from contamination by Vegatron radiation. A woman full of dignity, she wished for the peaceful coexistence of Earth and the Vegan Empire, but she was caught up in the fight between Duke Fleed and Minister Zuril, was gravely wounded, and died.
uncertain: 'Planet Ruby' (Ruubii-sei) - spelling unverified.
'Minister Zuril' (source: Zuril choukan).

254.en: A Royal Guard captain who came to Earth after being ordered by King Vega to defeat Grendizer. A confident tactician, he probed the captured Koji's memories with a confession device, raided the Robot Museum, obtained Great Mazinger, and fought Grendizer.
uncertain: 'Barendos' per Mazinger wiki; 'confession device' (jihaku souchi) is a literal rendering.

340.en: A young man who protected the world from Dr. Hell's Mechanical Beast army with Mazinger Z. A bright, straightforward hothead who pulls others along. Believing that the only way to solve the Earth's resource shortage was trade with aliens, he studied at NASA's UFO Center, analyzing UFO structures, developing UFOs and researching space science, but because UFOs frequently appeared in Japan, he returned home with the TFO that he had developed. He was the first to realize that Daisuke was Duke Fleed, and they became comrades bound by hot friendship and fought the Vegan Empire together. At first he used the TFO and was sometimes a hindrance, but after he became the pilot of the later-developed Double Spazer, he showed performance that was no less than Grendizer's.
uncertain: 'Mechanical Beast army' (Kikaijuu gundan) = Mechanical Beast Army / Corps.

394.en: A creature that had been lurking in the ancient sea, revived and grown to gigantic size because humans spilled oil into the sea. For that reason it loves oil and attacks tankers. It has the ability to fly, its dragon-neck-like tentacles regenerate instantly even when cut, and it can also rotate them to create strong winds. In addition, its flexible body is immune to missile attacks.
uncertain: Name spelling 'Dragonsaurus' (Mazinger wiki) vs the game's Doragonozaurusu.
